SELECT 
  COALESCE(p.bats, '') AS bats,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS award_winner_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) * 1.0 / (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) 
    FROM manager_award 
    WHERE player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM player)
  ) AS share_of_total
FROM manager_award ma
INNER JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '')
ORDER BY award_winner_count DESC;

WITH color_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color') as color,
    SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) as total_invoiced
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color')
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(total_invoiced) as avg_per_color
  FROM color_totals
),
color_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ct.total_invoiced,
    os.avg_per_color,
    ct.total_invoiced / (SELECT SUM(total_invoiced) FROM color_totals) as share,
    ct.total_invoiced - os.avg_per_color as above_average_amount
  FROM color_totals ct
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE ct.total_invoiced > os.avg_per_color
)
SELECT 
  AVG(total_invoiced) as avg_invoiced_amount,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(above_average_amount) as avg_above_average
FROM color_shares

WITH color_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color') AS color,
    SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS total_quantity
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color')
),
summary AS (
  SELECT 
    total_quantity,
    AVG(total_quantity) OVER () AS avg_per_color,
    SUM(total_quantity) OVER () AS total_all
  FROM color_totals
)
SELECT 
  AVG(CASE WHEN total_quantity > avg_per_color THEN total_quantity END) AS average_quantity,
  AVG(CASE WHEN total_quantity > avg_per_color THEN total_quantity / total_all END) AS average_share,
  AVG(CASE WHEN total_quantity > avg_per_color THEN total_quantity - avg_per_color END) AS average_excess
FROM summary;

WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    r.rental_id,
    i.store_id,
    SUM(p.amount) as rental_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
),
avg_rental AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_total) as avg_value FROM rental_totals
)
SELECT 
  rt.store_id,
  SUM(rt.rental_total) as combined_total,
  AVG(rt.rental_total) - (SELECT avg_value FROM avg_rental) as avg_beat
FROM rental_totals rt
WHERE rt.rental_total > (SELECT avg_value FROM avg_rental)
GROUP BY rt.store_id
ORDER BY rt.store_id

WITH rental_payments AS (
  SELECT 
    r.rental_id,
    i.store_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS rental_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  LEFT JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_total) AS avg_total
  FROM rental_payments
),
filtered_rentals AS (
  SELECT 
    rp.store_id,
    rp.rental_id,
    rp.rental_total,
    oa.avg_total,
    rp.rental_total - oa.avg_total AS excess
  FROM rental_payments rp
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE rp.rental_total > oa.avg_total
)
SELECT 
  store_id,
  SUM(rental_total) AS sum_of_totals,
  AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM filtered_rentals
GROUP BY store_id;

WITH grouped_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    p.product_color,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL 
          AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL 
          AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0
        THEN (ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost
      END
    ) AS avg_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  INNER JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE ili.order_item_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color
),
ranked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_quantity,
    avg_cost_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank
  FROM grouped_data
)
SELECT 
  order_item_id,
  product_color,
  avg_quantity,
  avg_cost_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked_data
WHERE rank <= 3;

WITH line_items_with_product AS (
  SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    ili.product_quantity,
    ili.derived_product_cost,
    ili.derived_total_cost,
    p.product_color
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  INNER JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
),
grouped_data AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0
        THEN (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / derived_total_cost 
      END
    ) as avg_cost_diff_ratio
  FROM line_items_with_product
  GROUP BY order_item_id, product_color
),
ranked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_quantity,
    avg_cost_diff_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY product_color 
      ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC NULLS LAST
    ) as rank
  FROM grouped_data
)
SELECT 
  order_item_id,
  product_color,
  avg_quantity,
  avg_cost_diff_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked_data
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY product_color, rank;

WITH transaction_regions AS (
  SELECT 
    t.amount,
    d.A3 as region
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(amount) as cross_region_average
  FROM transaction_regions
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(amount) as avg_amount,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count
  FROM transaction_regions
  GROUP BY region
),
filtered_regions AS (
  SELECT 
    r.avg_amount,
    r.transaction_count,
    (r.avg_amount - o.cross_region_average) as above_average
  FROM region_stats r
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE r.avg_amount > o.cross_region_average
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_amount) as avg_transaction_amount,
  AVG(transaction_count) as avg_transaction_count,
  AVG(above_average) as avg_above_cross_region
FROM filtered_regions;

WITH regional_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    d.A3,
    AVG(t.amount) as regional_avg,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
global_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(regional_avg) as mean_of_regional_avgs
  FROM regional_stats
),
filtered_regions AS (
  SELECT 
    rs.regional_avg,
    rs.transaction_count,
    rs.regional_avg - gm.mean_of_regional_avgs as excess
  FROM regional_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN global_mean gm
  WHERE rs.regional_avg > gm.mean_of_regional_avgs
)
SELECT
  AVG(regional_avg) as mean_of_filtered_averages,
  AVG(transaction_count) as mean_of_filtered_counts,
  AVG(excess) as mean_excess_amount
FROM filtered_regions;

WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) as avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_per_day_rate
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_avg_per_day AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) as overall_avg_per_day
  FROM rating_stats
)
SELECT 
  rs.rating,
  rs.avg_replacement_cost,
  rs.avg_per_day_rate,
  rs.avg_per_day_rate / oa.overall_avg_per_day as per_day_price_ratio
FROM rating_stats rs
CROSS JOIN overall_avg_per_day oa
ORDER BY rs.rating;

WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS mean_per_day_price FROM rating_stats) SELECT rs.rating, rs.avg_replacement_cost, rs.per_day_price, rs.per_day_price / om.mean_per_day_price AS per_day_price_ratio FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall_mean om;

WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    AlbumId,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count,
    CASE 
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds ELSE 0 END) > 0
      THEN SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(20,10)) ELSE 0 END) / 
           CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(20,10))
      ELSE NULL
    END AS bytes_per_ms_rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms_rate) AS mean_album_rate
  FROM album_rates
  WHERE bytes_per_ms_rate IS NOT NULL
),
above_mean_albums AS (
  SELECT 
    ar.track_count,
    ar.bytes_per_ms_rate,
    mr.mean_album_rate
  FROM album_rates ar
  CROSS JOIN mean_rate mr
  WHERE ar.bytes_per_ms_rate IS NOT NULL AND ar.bytes_per_ms_rate > mr.mean_album_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(bytes_per_ms_rate) AS average_rate,
  AVG(CAST(track_count AS DECIMAL(20,10))) AS average_track_count,
  AVG(bytes_per_ms_rate - mean_album_rate) AS average_above_mean
FROM above_mean_albums

WITH album_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(15,8)) / Milliseconds) as album_rate,
    COUNT(*) as track_count
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(album_rate) as overall_mean
  FROM album_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(album_stats.album_rate) as avg_rate,
  AVG(album_stats.track_count) as avg_track_count,
  AVG(album_stats.album_rate - mean_rate.overall_mean) as avg_excess
FROM album_stats
CROSS JOIN mean_rate
WHERE album_stats.album_rate > mean_rate.overall_mean

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) as avg_amount FROM budget b INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as mean_of_averages FROM event_averages) SELECT ea.event_name, ea.avg_amount, ea.avg_amount - oa.mean_of_averages as above_average, ea.avg_amount / oa.mean_of_averages as ratio_to_mean FROM event_averages ea CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE ea.avg_amount > oa.mean_of_averages ORDER BY ea.event_name

WITH event_budget_avg AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS per_event_avg FROM budget b INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(per_event_avg) AS overall_average FROM event_budget_avg), above_average_events AS (SELECT eba.event_name, eba.per_event_avg FROM event_budget_avg eba CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE eba.per_event_avg > oa.overall_average), kept_event_avg AS (SELECT AVG(per_event_avg) AS kept_average FROM above_average_events) SELECT aae.event_name, aae.per_event_avg, aae.per_event_avg - oa.overall_average, aae.per_event_avg / kea.kept_average FROM above_average_events aae CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa CROSS JOIN kept_event_avg kea ORDER BY aae.event_name;

WITH event_spend_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    SUM(spent) / SUM(amount) as spend_ratio
  FROM budget
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
avg_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) as avg_spend_ratio
  FROM event_spend_ratios
)

  e.spend_ratio / ar.avg_spend_ratio as relative_ratio

WITH budget_line_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    CASE 
      WHEN amount IS NOT NULL AND amount != 0 AND spent IS NOT NULL 
      THEN CAST(spent AS REAL) / CAST(amount AS REAL)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS line_ratio
  FROM budget
),
event_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    AVG(line_ratio) AS event_spend_ratio
  FROM budget_line_ratios
  WHERE line_ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(event_spend_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM event_ratios
)
SELECT 
  er.link_to_event AS event_id,
  er.event_spend_ratio AS spend_ratio,
  CASE 
    WHEN oa.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND oa.avg_ratio != 0
    THEN er.event_spend_ratio / oa.avg_ratio
    ELSE NULL
  END AS relative_ratio
FROM event_ratios er
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
ORDER BY 
  relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) as count
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY BillingState
),
global_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_invoices,
    AVG(CAST(count AS DECIMAL)) as avg_invoice_count
  FROM state_counts
),
filtered_states AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.count,
    CAST(sc.count AS DECIMAL) / CAST(gs.total_invoices AS DECIMAL) as share,
    gs.avg_invoice_count
  FROM state_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN global_stats gs
  WHERE sc.count > gs.avg_invoice_count
)
SELECT
  SUM(count) as total_invoices,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(CAST(count AS DECIMAL) - avg_invoice_count) as avg_above_average
FROM filtered_states

WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM Invoice
  WHERE BillingState IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY BillingState
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total, AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt
  FROM state_counts
),
with_metrics AS (
  SELECT sc.cnt, sc.cnt * 1.0 / t.total as share, t.avg_cnt
  FROM state_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT cnt, share, avg_cnt
  FROM with_metrics
  WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
)
SELECT
  SUM(cnt) as total_invoices,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) as avg_excess
FROM filtered

WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS overall_avg_price
  FROM InvoiceLine
),
invoice_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    i.InvoiceId,
    c.Country,
    AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS invoice_avg_price,
    AVG(il.UnitPrice) - (SELECT overall_avg_price FROM overall_avg) AS deviation
  FROM Invoice i
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
  JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
)
SELECT 
  InvoiceId,
  Country,
  invoice_avg_price,
  deviation,
  deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS deviation_above_country_avg
FROM invoice_summary
ORDER BY deviation_above_country_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH invoice_data AS (
  SELECT 
    i.InvoiceId,
    c.Country,
    AVG(il.UnitPrice) as invoice_avg_price
  FROM Invoice i
  JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
  GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(invoice_avg_price) as overall_avg_price
  FROM invoice_data
),
invoice_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    id.InvoiceId,
    id.Country,
    id.invoice_avg_price,
    id.invoice_avg_price - os.overall_avg_price as deviation
  FROM invoice_data id
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
),
country_avg_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    Country,
    AVG(deviation) as country_avg_deviation
  FROM invoice_deviations
  GROUP BY Country
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT 
    id.InvoiceId,
    id.Country,
    id.invoice_avg_price,
    id.deviation,
    id.deviation - cad.country_avg_deviation as final_value
  FROM invoice_deviations id
  LEFT JOIN country_avg_deviations cad ON (id.Country = cad.Country) OR (id.Country IS NULL AND cad.Country IS NULL)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    InvoiceId,
    Country,
    invoice_avg_price,
    deviation,
    final_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY final_value DESC NULLS LAST) as row_num
  FROM final_result
)
SELECT 
  InvoiceId,
  Country,
  invoice_avg_price,
  deviation,
  final_value
FROM ranked
WHERE row_num <= 10 
   OR final_value = (SELECT final_value FROM ranked WHERE row_num = 10)
ORDER BY final_value DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) as count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), with_share AS (SELECT count, count * 1.0 / SUM(count) OVER () as share FROM status_counts), avg_share_val AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_share) SELECT SUM(count) as total_count, AVG(share) as avg_share_above, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_val)) as above_average_excess FROM with_share WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_val)

WITH status_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(powerstatus, 'MISSING') as power_status, COUNT(*) as telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) as percentage_share FROM telescopes GROUP BY COALESCE(powerstatus, 'MISSING')), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(percentage_share) as avg_share FROM status_counts) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes, AVG(percentage_share) as average_share, AVG(percentage_share - overall_avg.avg_share) as average_excess FROM status_counts CROSS JOIN overall_avg WHERE percentage_share > overall_avg.avg_share

WITH counts_by_gender AS (
  SELECT 
    c.gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as count
  FROM Invoices i
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
with_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    gender,
    count,
    count * 1.0 / SUM(count) OVER () as share,
    1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () as avg_share
  FROM counts_by_gender
)
SELECT 
  gender,
  count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM with_stats
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC;

    count * 1.0 / SUM(count) OVER () as share,
    1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () as avg_share
  FROM counts_by_gender
)
SELECT 
  gender,
  count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM with_stats
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC;

  FROM Invoices i

shares_calc AS (

    gc.gender,
    gc.count,

  FROM gender_counts gc

),
average_share AS (

)

  sc.gender,
  sc.count,
  sc.share,
  sc.share - a.avg_share as difference
FROM shares_calc sc

WHERE sc.share > a.avg_share

WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    t.equipstatus,
    AVG(s.pulsepersec) as avg_pulse
  FROM signals s
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.equipstatus
),
mean1 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as mean1_value
  FROM status_averages
),
above_mean1 AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.equipstatus,
    sa.avg_pulse
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN mean1 m1
  WHERE sa.avg_pulse > m1.mean1_value
),
mean2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as mean2_value
  FROM above_mean1
),
final_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    am1.avg_pulse,
    m1.mean1_value,
    m2.mean2_value
  FROM above_mean1 am1
  CROSS JOIN mean1 m1
  CROSS JOIN mean2 m2
  WHERE am1.avg_pulse > m2.mean2_value
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_pulse) as final_avg_pulse,
  AVG(avg_pulse - mean1_value) as avg_excess_over_mean1,
  AVG(avg_pulse - mean2_value) as avg_excess_over_mean2
FROM final_statuses;

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT s.signalregistry, s.pulsepersec, t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus
  FROM signals s
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
),
telescope_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    telescregistry,
    equipstatus,
    AVG(pulsepersec) as telescope_avg
  FROM matched
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescregistry, equipstatus
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    equipstatus,
    AVG(telescope_avg) as status_avg
  FROM telescope_stats
  GROUP BY equipstatus
),
first_mean_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg) as first_mean FROM status_stats
),
above_first AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.equipstatus,
    ss.status_avg,
    ss.status_avg - fm.first_mean as excess_first
  FROM status_stats ss
  CROSS JOIN first_mean_val fm
  WHERE ss.status_avg > fm.first_mean
),
second_mean_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg) as second_mean FROM above_first
),
above_second AS (
  SELECT 
    af.equipstatus,
    af.status_avg,
    af.excess_first,
    af.status_avg - sm.second_mean as excess_second
  FROM above_first af
  CROSS JOIN second_mean_val sm
  WHERE af.status_avg > sm.second_mean
)
SELECT 
  AVG(status_avg) as avg_pulse_rate_average,
  AVG(excess_first) as avg_excess_over_first_mean,
  AVG(excess_second) as avg_excess_over_second_mean
FROM above_second

WITH account_trans AS (

    a.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
      WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN -t.amount
      ELSE 0
    END) as account_total,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count
  FROM trans t
  INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(account_total) as region_total
  FROM account_trans
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  at.account_id,
  at.region,
  at.account_total,
  at.transaction_count,
  CASE WHEN rt.region_total != 0 THEN CAST(at.account_total AS REAL) / rt.region_total ELSE NULL END as share
FROM account_trans at
INNER JOIN region_totals rt ON at.region = rt.region
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    o.timespan,
    COUNT(*) as match_count,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN f.rebrate IS NOT NULL AND f.feerate IS NOT NULL
      THEN f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)
    END) as avg_ratio
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
cross_group_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(match_count) as avg_match_count
  FROM group_stats
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT gs.match_count, gs.avg_ratio, cga.avg_match_count
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN cross_group_avg cga
  WHERE gs.match_count > cga.avg_match_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_avg_ratios,
  SUM(match_count) as total_match_counts,
  AVG(match_count - avg_match_count) as avg_excess_match_count
FROM filtered_groups

WITH country_avgs AS (
  SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country
),
overall_avg_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_average FROM country_avgs
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT country_avgs.country, country_avgs.avg_wins
  FROM country_avgs
  WHERE country_avgs.avg_wins > (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg_value)
),
above_group_avg_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as above_group_average FROM above_overall
),
final_countries AS (
  SELECT above_overall.country, above_overall.avg_wins
  FROM above_overall
  WHERE above_overall.avg_wins > (SELECT above_group_average FROM above_group_avg_value)
)
SELECT
  AVG(final_countries.avg_wins) as mean_of_final_countries,
  AVG(final_countries.avg_wins) - (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg_value) as mean_exceeding_overall,
  AVG(final_countries.avg_wins) - (SELECT above_group_average FROM above_group_avg_value) as mean_exceeding_above_group
FROM final_countries

WITH constructor_wins_gained AS (
  SELECT cs.constructorId, cs.raceId, r.year, r.round, c.country,
    cs.wins - COALESCE(LAG(cs.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year ORDER BY r.round), 0) AS wins_gained
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
),
country_avg_wins AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(wins_gained) AS avg_wins_gained
  FROM constructor_wins_gained
  GROUP BY country
),
global_mean_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained) AS global_mean
  FROM country_avg_wins
),
above_global AS (
  SELECT caw.country, caw.avg_wins_gained, caw.avg_wins_gained - gm.global_mean AS excess_global
  FROM country_avg_wins caw
  CROSS JOIN global_mean_cte gm
  WHERE caw.avg_wins_gained > gm.global_mean
),
above_avg_group_mean_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained) AS above_avg_mean
  FROM above_global
),
final_countries AS (
  SELECT ag.avg_wins_gained, ag.excess_global, ag.avg_wins_gained - aam.above_avg_mean AS excess_above_avg
  FROM above_global ag
  CROSS JOIN above_avg_group_mean_cte aam
  WHERE ag.avg_wins_gained > aam.above_avg_mean
)
SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained) AS final_mean, AVG(excess_global) AS mean_excess_global, AVG(excess_above_avg) AS mean_excess_above_avg
FROM final_countries;

WITH transaction_aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) AS avg_shortintrt,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist
),
baselines AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(avg_shortintrt) AS baseline_shortintrt
  FROM transaction_aggregates
  WHERE avg_shortintrt IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  ta.transreg,
  ta.ordertypedist,
  ta.avg_shortintrt,
  ta.avg_optvolrt,
  CASE 
    WHEN bl.baseline_shortintrt IS NOT NULL AND ta.avg_shortintrt IS NOT NULL 
    THEN ta.avg_shortintrt / bl.baseline_shortintrt 
    ELSE NULL 
  END AS ratio
FROM transaction_aggregates ta
LEFT JOIN baselines bl ON ta.ordertypedist = bl.ordertypedist
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT

WITH line_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(cost) as total_cost,
    COUNT(*) as expense_count
  FROM expense
  GROUP BY link_to_budget
),
average_total AS (

FROM line_totals lt
CROSS JOIN average_total at

WITH fielding_with_bats AS (
  SELECT f.*, p.bats
  FROM fielding f
  LEFT JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id
),
hand_counts AS (
  SELECT bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM fielding_with_bats
  GROUP BY bats
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) AS total_count, AVG(count) AS avg_count
  FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT
  hc.batting_hand,
  hc.count,
  hc.count * 1.0 / t.total_count AS share,
  hc.count - t.avg_count AS above_average
FROM hand_counts hc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE hc.count > t.avg_count
ORDER BY hc.count DESC;

WITH fielding_bats AS (

    p.bats,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM fielding f
  JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.bats
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_count,
    AVG(count) as avg_count
  FROM fielding_bats
)
SELECT 
  fb.bats,
  fb.count,
  CAST(fb.count AS FLOAT) / s.total_count as share,
  fb.count - s.avg_count as above_average
FROM fielding_bats fb
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE fb.count > s.avg_count;

WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN archstat IS NULL THEN 'Missing' ELSE archstat END as archstat,
    COUNT(*) as project_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN archstat IS NULL THEN 'Missing' ELSE archstat END
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(project_count) as total_projects
  FROM status_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.archstat as status,
    sc.project_count as tally,
    sc.project_count::NUMERIC / t.total_projects as share,
    AVG(sc.project_count::NUMERIC / t.total_projects) OVER () as avg_share
  FROM status_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  status,
  tally,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC

WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT
    archstat,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(cnt) as total_cnt,
    COUNT(*) as num_statuses
  FROM status_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT
    sc.archstat,
    sc.cnt,
    CAST(sc.cnt AS FLOAT) / t.total_cnt as share,
    1.0 / CAST(t.num_statuses AS FLOAT) as avg_share
  FROM status_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT
  archstat,
  cnt as count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_avg
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC;

SELECT orders.orderflow AS status, AVG(orderexecutions.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS num_executions, COUNT(*)::REAL / (SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ()) AS fraction_of_all_executions FROM orders INNER JOIN orderexecutions ON orders.recordvault = orderexecutions.ordersmark GROUP BY orders.orderflow ORDER BY orders.orderflow;

WITH total_execs AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM orders o
  INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
)
SELECT 
  o.orderflow,
  AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_fillcount,
  COUNT(*) as execution_count,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL) / CAST((SELECT total_count FROM total_execs) AS DECIMAL) as fraction
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
GROUP BY o.orderflow

WITH member_totals AS (
  SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) as total_amount
  FROM income
  GROUP BY link_to_member
),
global_totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_amount) as grand_total, COUNT(*) as member_count
  FROM member_totals
),
member_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.total_amount,
    mt.total_amount / gt.grand_total as share,
    1.0 / gt.member_count as avg_share,
    gt.grand_total
  FROM member_totals mt
  CROSS JOIN global_totals gt
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    total_amount,
    share,
    avg_share,
    grand_total,
    (share - avg_share) * grand_total as amount_above_avg
  FROM member_analysis
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(total_amount) as combined_amount,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(amount_above_avg) as average_amount_above_average
FROM above_avg

WITH grouped_income AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_member,
    SUM(amount) as group_sum
  FROM income
  WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_member
),
total_income AS (
  SELECT SUM(group_sum) as total_sum
  FROM grouped_income
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    gi.group_sum,
    CAST(gi.group_sum AS REAL) / CAST(ti.total_sum AS REAL) AS share
  FROM grouped_income gi, total_income ti
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_all_shares
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(s.group_sum) as total_amount,
  AVG(s.share) as average_share,
  AVG(s.share - a.avg_all_shares) as avg_diff_from_avg
FROM shares s, avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_all_shares;

WITH signed_trans AS (
  SELECT
    t.trans_id,
    t.account_id,
    t.balance,
    CASE
      WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
      WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
    END as signed_amount
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
),
freq_stats AS (
  SELECT
    a.frequency,
    AVG(st.signed_amount) as avg_signed,
    AVG(st.balance) as avg_balance
  FROM signed_trans st
  INNER JOIN account a ON st.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY a.frequency
),
filtered_freq AS (
  SELECT
    avg_signed,
    avg_balance
  FROM freq_stats
  WHERE avg_signed > (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) FROM freq_stats)
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_signed) as avg_signed_avg,
  AVG(avg_balance) as avg_balance_avg,
  AVG(avg_signed - (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) FROM freq_stats)) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_freq;

WITH account_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency,
    AVG(CASE 
        WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
        WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN -t.amount
        ELSE NULL
      END) as avg_signed_amount,
    AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance
  FROM account a
  INNER JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency
),
frequency_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    frequency,
    AVG(avg_signed_amount) as avg_freq_signed_amount,
    AVG(avg_balance) as avg_freq_balance
  FROM account_stats
  GROUP BY frequency
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_freq_signed_amount) as avg_of_avg_signed_amounts,
  AVG(avg_freq_balance) as avg_of_avg_balances,
  AVG(avg_freq_signed_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_freq_signed_amount) FROM frequency_stats)) as avg_excess
FROM frequency_stats
WHERE avg_freq_signed_amount > (SELECT AVG(avg_freq_signed_amount) FROM frequency_stats);

WITH per_order_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NO_ORDER_REF') as order_id,
    AVG(remaincount) as avg_remain
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(ordersmark, 'NO_ORDER_REF')
),
overall_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(remaincount) as overall_avg
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT 
    poa.order_id,
    poa.avg_remain,
    poa.avg_remain - oav.overall_avg as excess_over_overall
  FROM per_order_avg poa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_val oav
  WHERE poa.avg_remain > oav.overall_avg
),
group_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as group_avg
  FROM above_overall
),
final_selection AS (
  SELECT 
    ao.avg_remain,
    ao.excess_over_overall,
    ao.avg_remain - gav.group_avg as excess_over_group
  FROM above_overall ao
  CROSS JOIN group_avg_val gav
  WHERE ao.avg_remain > gav.group_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_remain) as avg_of_final_averages,
  AVG(excess_over_overall) as avg_excess_over_overall,
  AVG(excess_over_group) as avg_excess_over_group
FROM final_selection

  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL

  FROM per_order_avg

  SELECT 
    order_key,
    avg_remaincount
  FROM above_first
  WHERE avg_remaincount > (SELECT bench2 FROM second_benchmark)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_remaincount) AS avg_of_remaining_averages,
  AVG(avg_remaincount - (SELECT bench1 FROM first_benchmark)) AS avg_excess_over_first,
  AVG(avg_remaincount - (SELECT bench2 FROM second_benchmark)) AS avg_excess_over_second
FROM above_second;

WITH district_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    district_id,
    COUNT(*) as account_count
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
total_accounts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM account
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.district_id,
    dc.account_count,
    CAST(dc.account_count AS REAL) / CAST(ta.total AS REAL) as share,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(dc.account_count AS REAL) / CAST(ta.total AS REAL) DESC) as dense_rank
  FROM district_counts dc, total_accounts ta
)
SELECT 
  district_id,
  account_count,
  share
FROM with_share
WHERE dense_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share DESC;

WITH patient_avg_ratios AS (

    AVG(CAST(HGB AS REAL) / HCT) as avg_ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL

),
cross_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg
  FROM patient_avg_ratios
),
selected_patients AS (
  SELECT par.ID, par.avg_ratio
  FROM patient_avg_ratios par
  CROSS JOIN cross_avg ca
  WHERE par.avg_ratio > ca.overall_avg
),
patient_pics AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.ID,
    sp.avg_ratio,
    AVG(l.PIC) as avg_pic
  FROM selected_patients sp

  WHERE l.PIC IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sp.ID, sp.avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  AVG(pp.avg_pic) as mean_avg_pic,
  AVG(pp.avg_ratio) as mean_ratios,
  AVG(pp.avg_ratio - (SELECT overall_avg FROM cross_avg)) as mean_exceedance
FROM patient_pics pp;

WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(modelconf) as val
  FROM compliancecase
  WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL
),
status_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    brokrepstat,
    AVG(modelconf) as status_avg
  FROM compliancecase
  WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
above_avg_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.brokrepstat,
    sa.status_avg,
    sa.status_avg - oa.val as above_average
  FROM status_avgs sa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE oa.val IS NOT NULL
    AND sa.status_avg > oa.val
),
mean_of_qualifying AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg) as val
  FROM above_avg_statuses
)
SELECT 
  aas.brokrepstat as status,
  aas.status_avg,
  aas.above_average,
  aas.status_avg / mq.val as ratio
FROM above_avg_statuses aas
CROSS JOIN mean_of_qualifying mq
WHERE mq.val IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY aas.status_avg DESC

WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(brokrepstat, 'NO_STATUS') as status,
    AVG(modelconf) as avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(brokrepstat, 'NO_STATUS')
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) as baseline_value
  FROM status_averages
),
qualifying_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.status,
    sa.avg_modelconf,
    b.baseline_value
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE sa.avg_modelconf > b.baseline_value
),
qualifying_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) as mean_qualifying
  FROM qualifying_statuses
)
SELECT 
  qs.status,
  qs.avg_modelconf,
  qs.avg_modelconf - qs.baseline_value as diff_from_baseline,
  qs.avg_modelconf / qm.mean_qualifying as ratio_to_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying_statuses qs
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm
WHERE qs.baseline_value IS NOT NULL AND qm.mean_qualifying IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY qs.status;

),

),

  SELECT 
    pd.player_id,

  CROSS JOIN grand_avg ga
),

  FROM player_index
  GROUP BY bats
),
player_gap AS (

    pi.player_id,

)

  index_value as index,

FROM player_gap
ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST

WITH fund_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN sp.boxx IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxx != 0 AND sp.boxy IS NOT NULL 
      THEN (sp.boxy - sp.boxx) / sp.boxx 
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN sp.volm3 IS NOT NULL AND sp.volm3 != 0 AND sp.aream2 IS NOT NULL 
      THEN sp.aream2 / sp.volm3 
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS area_vol_ratio
  FROM scanspatial sp
  JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(area_vol_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM fund_metrics
  WHERE area_vol_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  fm.fundflux,
  fm.avg_y_vs_x_diff,
  fm.area_vol_ratio,
  fm.area_vol_ratio - oa.avg_ratio AS above_average
FROM fund_metrics fm
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE fm.area_vol_ratio > oa.avg_ratio
  AND fm.area_vol_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY fm.area_vol_ratio DESC;

mean_above_baseline AS (

final_ratings AS (

WITH trader_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(t.tradekind, 'No Type') AS trader_type,
    COUNT(*)::numeric AS type_count
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY COALESCE(t.tradekind, 'No Type')
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(type_count) AS avg_count,
    SUM(type_count) AS total_count
  FROM trader_counts
)
SELECT 
  tc.trader_type,
  tc.type_count,
  tc.type_count / s.total_count AS ratio,
  tc.type_count - s.avg_count AS above_average
FROM trader_counts tc
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE s.avg_count IS NOT NULL
  AND tc.type_count > s.avg_count
ORDER BY tc.type_count DESC;

WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tr.trdref) as count
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(count) as average,
    SUM(count) as total
  FROM type_counts
)
SELECT
  tc.tradekind,
  tc.count,
  CAST(tc.count AS NUMERIC) / CAST(s.total AS NUMERIC) as proportion,
  CAST(tc.count AS NUMERIC) - s.average as above_average
FROM type_counts tc
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE tc.count > s.average
  AND s.average IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY tc.tradekind;

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat
  FROM scanconservation sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    insurstat,
    COUNT(*) as record_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched) as fraction
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat
),
ranked AS (

ORDER BY

)
SELECT

FROM filtered_orders

ORDER BY timespan, rnk

WITH order_executions AS (
  SELECT 
    o.recordvault,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) FILTER (WHERE oe.fillcount IS NOT NULL) AS avg_fill
  FROM orders o
  INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.timespan
),
timespan_means AS (
  SELECT 
    timespan,
    AVG(avg_fill) AS mean_avg_fill
  FROM order_executions
  WHERE avg_fill IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY timespan
),
filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    oe.recordvault,
    oe.timespan,
    oe.avg_fill,
    (oe.avg_fill - tm.mean_avg_fill) AS exceeds,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY oe.timespan ORDER BY oe.avg_fill DESC) AS rank_in_timespan
  FROM order_executions oe
  JOIN timespan_means tm ON oe.timespan = tm.timespan
  WHERE oe.avg_fill IS NOT NULL
    AND oe.avg_fill > tm.mean_avg_fill
)
SELECT 
  recordvault AS ordersmark,
  timespan,
  avg_fill,
  exceeds,
  rank_in_timespan
FROM filtered_orders
WHERE rank_in_timespan <= 3
ORDER BY timespan, rank_in_timespan;

WITH group_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        link_to_major as major_id,
        COUNT(*) as member_count
    FROM member
    WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_major
),
stats AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL) as total_members,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_major) FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL) as num_majors
)
SELECT 
    gc.major_id,
    gc.member_count,
    gc.member_count * 1.0 / s.total_members as share_of_total,
    gc.member_count * 1.0 / (s.total_members * 1.0 / s.num_majors) as count_vs_avg
FROM group_counts gc
CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY count_vs_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH group_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        link_to_major,
        COUNT(*) as member_count
    FROM member
    WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_major
)
SELECT 
    link_to_major,
    member_count,
    member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () as fraction_of_total,
    member_count * COUNT(*) OVER () * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () as ratio_to_avg
FROM group_counts
ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH sex_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg,
    AVG(e.ANA) as avg_ana
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY p.SEX
),
ana_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ana) as mean_ana
  FROM sex_averages
)
SELECT 
  sex_averages.SEX,
  sex_averages.avg_acl_igg,
  sex_averages.avg_ana,
  sex_averages.avg_ana / ana_mean.mean_ana as ana_ratio
FROM sex_averages
CROSS JOIN ana_mean

WITH race_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) as num_races FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), totals AS (SELECT SUM(num_races) as total_races, COUNT(*) as total_circuits FROM race_counts), circuit_stats AS (SELECT rc.circuitId, rc.num_races, rc.num_races * 1.0 / t.total_races as share, (rc.num_races * 1.0 / t.total_races) - (1.0 / t.total_circuits) as margin_above_average FROM race_counts rc CROSS JOIN totals t) SELECT circuitId, num_races, share, margin_above_average FROM circuit_stats WHERE margin_above_average > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH race_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    circuitId,
    COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
),
total_races AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM races
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    rc.circuitId,
    rc.race_count,
    CAST(rc.race_count AS FLOAT) / tr.total AS share
  FROM race_counts rc
  CROSS JOIN total_races tr
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    s.circuitId,
    s.race_count,
    s.share,
    s.share - a.avg_share AS excess
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN average_share a
  WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    circuitId,
    race_count,
    share,
    excess,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rn
  FROM filtered
)
SELECT 
  circuitId,
  race_count,
  share,
  excess
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10 
   OR excess = (SELECT excess FROM ranked WHERE rn = 10)
ORDER BY excess DESC

WITH race_avg_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    r.raceId,
    c.country,
    AVG(ds.wins) as race_avg_wins
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
),
country_avg_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(race_avg_wins) as country_avg
  FROM race_avg_wins
  GROUP BY country
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM country_avg_wins
),
above_overall_cte AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    c.country_avg,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM country_avg_wins c
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE c.country_avg > oa.overall_avg
),
above_group_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg) as above_group_avg
  FROM above_overall_cte
)
SELECT 
  ao.country,
  ao.country_avg,
  ao.country_avg - ao.overall_avg as above_overall,
  ao.country_avg - ag.above_group_avg as above_group
FROM above_overall_cte ao
CROSS JOIN above_group_cte ag
WHERE ao.country_avg > ag.above_group_avg
ORDER BY ao.country_avg DESC;

WITH race_country AS (
  SELECT 
    r.raceId,
    c.country
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
),
per_race_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rc.country,
    AVG(ds.wins) as race_avg_wins
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN race_country rc ON ds.raceId = rc.raceId
  GROUP BY rc.raceId, rc.country
),
per_country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(race_avg_wins) as country_avg_wins
  FROM per_race_averages
  GROUP BY country
),
overall_benchmark_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg_wins) as benchmark
  FROM per_country_averages
),
countries_above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT 
    pca.country,
    pca.country_avg_wins,
    ob.benchmark
  FROM per_country_averages pca
  CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark_calc ob
  WHERE pca.country_avg_wins > ob.benchmark
),
second_mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg_wins) as second_mean
  FROM countries_above_benchmark
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT 
    cab.country,
    cab.country_avg_wins,
    cab.benchmark,
    sm.second_mean
  FROM countries_above_benchmark cab
  CROSS JOIN second_mean_calc sm
  WHERE cab.country_avg_wins > sm.second_mean
)
SELECT 
  country,
  country_avg_wins as average,
  country_avg_wins - benchmark as above_benchmark,
  country_avg_wins - second_mean as above_second_mean
FROM final_result
ORDER BY country;

WITH sentiment_trans AS (
  SELECT s.instownpct, t.ordertypedist
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) as avg_val FROM sentiment_trans
),
order_type_avgs AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) as avg_val
  FROM sentiment_trans
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  AVG(st.instownpct) as avg_ownership,
  AVG(st.instownpct / ota.avg_val) as avg_ratio_to_order_type_avg,
  AVG(st.instownpct - oa.avg_val) as avg_excess_over_overall_avg
FROM sentiment_trans st
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
JOIN order_type_avgs ota ON st.ordertypedist = ota.ordertypedist
WHERE st.instownpct > oa.avg_val;

WITH units AS (
  SELECT s.sentreg, s.instownpct, t.ordertypedist
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
),
mix_baselines AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) as baseline
  FROM units
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_avg
  FROM units
),
units_with_baseline AS (
  SELECT u.sentreg, u.instownpct, u.ordertypedist, mb.baseline, oa.overall_avg
  FROM units u
  JOIN mix_baselines mb ON u.ordertypedist = mb.ordertypedist
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
),
kept_units AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM units_with_baseline
  WHERE instownpct > overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(instownpct) as avg_ownership_kept,
  AVG(instownpct / baseline) as avg_ownership_ratio,
  AVG(instownpct - overall_avg) as avg_excess_ownership
FROM kept_units;

WITH counts AS (SELECT o.recordvault, o.orderflow, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.orderflow), status_totals AS (SELECT orderflow, SUM(cnt) as status_total, COUNT(*) as combo_count FROM counts GROUP BY orderflow), combo_stats AS (SELECT c.recordvault, c.orderflow, c.cnt, c.cnt * 1.0 / st.status_total as share, 1.0 / st.combo_count as avg_share FROM counts c JOIN status_totals st ON c.orderflow = st.orderflow) SELECT recordvault, orderflow, cnt, share, share - avg_share as gap_above_avg FROM combo_stats WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY gap_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT 
    r.ordervault,
    o.orderflow,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    orderflow,
    SUM(cnt) as status_total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_combinations,
    1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_share
  FROM counts
  GROUP BY orderflow
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    c.ordervault,
    c.orderflow,
    c.cnt,
    c.cnt::FLOAT / ss.status_total_count as share,
    c.cnt::FLOAT / ss.status_total_count - ss.avg_share as diff,
    ss.avg_share
  FROM counts c
  JOIN status_stats ss ON c.orderflow = ss.orderflow
)
SELECT 
  ordervault,
  orderflow as status,
  cnt as count,
  share,
  diff
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH dept_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    maj.department,
    COUNT(m.member_id) as member_count
  FROM member m
  INNER JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
  GROUP BY maj.department
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(member_count) as total_members,
    COUNT(*) as num_departments
  FROM dept_counts
)
SELECT 
  dc.department,
  dc.member_count,
  CAST(dc.member_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_members as share,
  CAST(dc.member_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_members - 1.0 / t.num_departments as diff_from_avg
FROM dept_counts dc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE CAST(dc.member_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_members > 1.0 / t.num_departments
ORDER BY share DESC

WITH department_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ma.department,
    COUNT(m.member_id) as member_count
  FROM member m
  JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
  GROUP BY ma.department
),
total_members AS (
  SELECT SUM(member_count) as total FROM department_counts
),
department_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.department,
    dc.member_count,
    CAST(dc.member_count AS REAL) / tm.total as share
  FROM department_counts dc
  CROSS JOIN total_members tm
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM department_shares
)
SELECT 
  ds.department,
  ds.member_count,
  ds.share,
  ds.share - avs.avg_share as share_minus_average
FROM department_shares ds
CROSS JOIN average_share avs
WHERE ds.share > avs.avg_share
ORDER BY ds.department;

WITH gender_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as invoiced_order_count
  FROM Customers c
  JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) as avg_count
  FROM gender_counts
)
SELECT 
  AVG(gc.invoiced_order_count) as average_figure,
  AVG(gc.invoiced_order_count - ac.avg_count) as average_excess
FROM gender_counts gc
CROSS JOIN average_count ac
WHERE gc.invoiced_order_count > ac.avg_count

WITH invoice_orders_by_gender AS (
  SELECT 
    c.gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as invoiced_order_count
  FROM Invoices i
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
gender_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    gender,
    invoiced_order_count,
    AVG(invoiced_order_count) OVER () as overall_avg
  FROM invoice_orders_by_gender
)
SELECT 
  AVG(invoiced_order_count) as avg_invoiced_order_count,

WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS num_films
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM rating_stats
)
SELECT 
  rs.rating,
  rs.ratio,
  rs.num_films,
  rs.ratio - oa.avg_ratio AS deviation
FROM rating_stats rs
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa;

WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS num_films
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT 
  rating,
  ratio,
  num_films,
  ratio - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM rating_stats) AS ratio_minus_avg
FROM rating_stats
ORDER BY rating

WITH qc_with_projects AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing') as fundflux
  FROM scanqc q
  INNER JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) as qc_count
  FROM qc_with_projects
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
stats AS (
  SELECT SUM(qc_count)::numeric as total_qc, COUNT(*) as num_funding_sources
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  g.fundflux,
  g.qc_count,
  g.qc_count::numeric / s.total_qc as fraction_of_total,
  g.qc_count::numeric / (s.total_qc / s.num_funding_sources) as count_divided_by_avg
FROM grouped g
CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY g.fundflux

WITH qc_projects AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    p.arcregistry,
    p.fundflux
  FROM scanqc sq
  INNER JOIN projects p ON sq.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
funding_stats AS (
  SELECT
    fundflux,
    COUNT(DISTINCT arcregistry) AS num_projects
  FROM qc_projects
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(num_projects) AS total_projects,
    COUNT(*) AS num_funding_sources
  FROM funding_stats
)
SELECT
  f.fundflux,
  f.num_projects,
  f.num_projects::NUMERIC / t.total_projects::NUMERIC AS fraction_of_total,
  f.num_projects::NUMERIC / (t.total_projects::NUMERIC / t.num_funding_sources::NUMERIC) AS divided_by_average
FROM funding_stats f
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY f.fundflux NULLS LAST;

WITH telescope_avgs AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as overall_average
  FROM telescope_avgs
)
SELECT 
  ta.telescref,
  ta.avg_modindex,
  ta.avg_modindex - oa.overall_average as exceeds_overall,
  ta.avg_modindex / oa.overall_average as ratio_to_average
FROM telescope_avgs ta
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE ta.avg_modindex > oa.overall_average
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH per_telescope_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    AVG(modindex) as telescope_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(telescope_avg) as overall_mean
  FROM per_telescope_avg
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    pta.telescref,
    pta.telescope_avg
  FROM per_telescope_avg pta
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE pta.telescope_avg > oa.overall_mean
),
above_avg_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(telescope_avg) as above_avg_mean
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT 
  aa.telescref,
  aa.telescope_avg,
  aa.telescope_avg - oa.overall_mean as above_overall,
  aa.telescope_avg / aam.above_avg_mean as ratio
FROM above_average aa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
CROSS JOIN above_avg_mean aam
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH linked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.transref,
    sf.optvolrt,
    trd.tradekind
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader trd ON tr.trdref = trd.tradereg
),
pair_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    transref,
    tradekind,
    AVG(optvolrt) as pair_avg_optvolrt
  FROM linked_data
  GROUP BY transref, tradekind
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) as overall_avg_optvolrt
  FROM linked_data
),
pair_with_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.transref,
    pa.tradekind,
    pa.pair_avg_optvolrt,
    pa.pair_avg_optvolrt - oa.overall_avg_optvolrt as deviation
  FROM pair_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE oa.overall_avg_optvolrt IS NOT NULL
),
type_avg_deviation AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(deviation) as type_avg_deviation
  FROM pair_with_deviations
  WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pwd.transref,
    pwd.tradekind,

      WHEN SUM(derived_total_cost) != 0 
      THEN SUM(derived_product_cost) / SUM(derived_total_cost) 
      ELSE NULL
    END as invoice_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  WHERE derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL 
    AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
average_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM invoice_ratios
  WHERE invoice_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ir.invoice_number,
  ir.invoice_ratio,
  ir.line_item_count,
  ir.invoice_ratio / ar.avg_ratio as relative_ratio
FROM invoice_ratios ir
CROSS JOIN average_ratio ar
WHERE ar.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  relative_ratio IS NULL ASC,
  relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH group_stats AS (

    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,

  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),

  g.site_code,

  g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap,
  g.avg_remaining_storage / o.mean_value AS storage_ratio
FROM group_stats g
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
WHERE o.mean_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST, g.site_code
LIMIT 10;

WITH budget_ratios AS (

    e.event_id,
    e.location,
    CASE 
      WHEN b.amount = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (b.spent - b.amount) / CAST(b.amount AS REAL)
    END AS ratio
  FROM budget b
  JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
event_avg_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    event_id,
    location,
    AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM budget_ratios
  GROUP BY event_id, location
),
ranked_events AS (
  SELECT 
    event_id,
    location,
    avg_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY avg_ratio DESC NULLS LAST) as rank
  FROM event_avg_ratios
)

  event_id,
  location,
  avg_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked_events
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY location, rank, event_id

  AVG(avg_rebtotal) as mean_avg_rebtotal,
  AVG(avg_rel_gap) as mean_avg_rel_gap,

WITH per_txn AS (

  GROUP BY transref

  FROM per_txn

  SELECT p.transref, p.txn_avg
  FROM per_txn p, overall_avg_val o
  WHERE p.txn_avg > o.overall_avg

kept_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(txn_avg) as kept_avg
  FROM kept_txns

SELECT 
  k.transref,

WITH city_qualifying_counts AS (

  JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  GROUP BY c.location
),

  SELECT 
    SUM(qualifying_count) as total_qualifying,
    COUNT(*) as num_cities
  FROM city_qualifying_counts

FROM city_qualifying_counts cqc
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE CAST(cqc.qualifying_count AS FLOAT) / s.total_qualifying > 1.0 / s.num_cities
ORDER BY cqc.city;

WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.location,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  GROUP BY c.location
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as grand_total,
    COUNT(*) as num_cities
  FROM city_counts
)
SELECT 
  cc.location,
  cc.count,
  cc.count * 1.0 / t.grand_total as share,
  (cc.count * 1.0 / t.grand_total) - (1.0 / t.num_cities) as above_average
FROM city_counts cc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE (cc.count * 1.0 / t.grand_total) > (1.0 / t.num_cities)
ORDER BY cc.location;

WITH patient_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    L.ID,
    P.SEX,
    AVG(L.ALB) as patient_alb_avg,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN L.UN IS NOT NULL AND L.`T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND L.`T-BIL` != 0 
      THEN L.UN / L.`T-BIL` 
      ELSE NULL 
    END) as patient_ratio_avg
  FROM Laboratory L
  INNER JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
  WHERE P.SEX IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY L.ID, P.SEX
),
sex_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    SEX,
    AVG(patient_alb_avg) as sex_alb_avg,
    AVG(patient_ratio_avg) as sex_ratio_avg
  FROM patient_averages
  GROUP BY SEX
),
overall_mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(sex_alb_avg) as overall_mean
  FROM sex_averages
)
SELECT 
  sa.SEX,
  sa.sex_alb_avg,
  sa.sex_ratio_avg,
  sa.sex_alb_avg - om.overall_mean as alb_above_mean
FROM sex_averages sa
CROSS JOIN overall_mean_calc om
WHERE sa.sex_alb_avg > om.overall_mean
ORDER BY sa.SEX;

WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) as phase_avg,
    COUNT(t.bandusagepct) as phase_count
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation

WITH country_avgs AS (

country_averages AS (

WITH account_transaction_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    c.town_city,
    COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count
  FROM Accounts a
  INNER JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
  WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(transaction_count AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_count
  FROM account_transaction_counts
),
town_totals AS (
  SELECT town_city, SUM(transaction_count) AS town_total
  FROM account_transaction_counts
  GROUP BY town_city
)
SELECT 
  atc.account_id,
  atc.town_city,
  atc.transaction_count,
  CAST(atc.transaction_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / tt.town_total AS share_of_town_transactions,
  CAST(atc.transaction_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / a.avg_count AS ratio_to_average
FROM account_transaction_counts atc
CROSS JOIN averages a
JOIN town_totals tt ON atc.town_city = tt.town_city
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

),
averages AS (

),

    COUNT(ft.transaction_id) as transaction_count

  WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city
),
town_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    town_city,
    SUM(transaction_count) as town_total
  FROM account_transactions
  GROUP BY town_city
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(transaction_count) as overall_avg
  FROM account_transactions
)
SELECT 
  at.account_id,
  at.town_city,
  at.transaction_count,
  at.transaction_count / tt.town_total as share_of_town,
  at.transaction_count / os.overall_avg as ratio_to_average
FROM account_transactions at
JOIN town_totals tt ON at.town_city = tt.town_city
CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH patient_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(l.WBC) as avg_wbc,
    AVG(CASE WHEN l.HGB IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT != 0 THEN l.HGB / l.HCT ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio
  FROM Patient p
  INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_ratio
  FROM patient_stats
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ps.ID,
  ps.SEX,
  ps.avg_wbc,
  ps.avg_ratio as ratio,
  ps.avg_ratio - om.mean_ratio as gap
FROM patient_stats ps
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ps.avg_ratio > om.mean_ratio
ORDER BY gap IS NOT NULL DESC, gap DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH patient_lab AS (
  SELECT 
    l.ID,
    p.SEX,
    l.WBC,
    l.HGB,
    l.HCT,
    CASE WHEN l.HGB IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL 
         THEN l.HGB / l.HCT 
         ELSE NULL 
    END AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
),
patient_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    SEX,
    AVG(WBC) AS avg_wbc,
    AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM patient_lab
  GROUP BY ID, SEX
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
  FROM patient_stats
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ps.ID,
  ps.SEX,
  ps.avg_wbc,
  ps.avg_ratio,
  ps.avg_ratio - om.mean_ratio AS diff
FROM patient_stats ps
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ps.avg_ratio > om.mean_ratio
ORDER BY 
  diff IS NULL,
  diff DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH major_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        maj.major_id,
        maj.department,
        COUNT(m.member_id) as member_count,
        COUNT(m.member_id) * 1.0 / 
            SUM(COUNT(m.member_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY maj.department) as share
    FROM member m
    INNER JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
    GROUP BY maj.major_id, maj.department
),
dept_avgs AS (
    SELECT 
        major_id,
        department,
        member_count,
        share,
        AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) as dept_avg_share
    FROM major_shares
)
SELECT 
    major_id,
    department,
    member_count,
    share,
    share - dept_avg_share as above_average
FROM dept_avgs
WHERE share > dept_avg_share
ORDER BY above_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH total_members AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as total_count
  FROM member
  WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL
),
major_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    maj.major_id,
    maj.department,
    COUNT(m.member_id) as member_count,
    COUNT(m.member_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT total_count FROM total_members) as share
  FROM member m
  INNER JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
  GROUP BY maj.major_id, maj.department
),
dept_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    department,
    AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM major_shares
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT 
  ms.major_id,
  ms.department,
  ms.member_count,
  ms.share,
  ms.share - da.avg_share as difference_above_avg
FROM major_shares ms
INNER JOIN dept_avg da ON ms.department = da.department
WHERE ms.share > da.avg_share
ORDER BY difference_above_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH global_avg AS (

),
station_avgs AS (

  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
),
above_average_stations AS (
  SELECT sa.station_avg_usage
  FROM station_avgs sa
  CROSS JOIN global_avg ga
  WHERE sa.station_avg_usage > ga.global_avg_usage
)
SELECT 
  AVG(station_avg_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage,
  AVG(station_avg_usage) - (SELECT global_avg_usage FROM global_avg) AS above_average
FROM above_average_stations;

WITH station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS baseline FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), above_baseline AS (SELECT sa.station_avg, sa.station_avg - oa.baseline AS excess FROM station_avgs sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.station_avg > oa.baseline) SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS mean_of_station_avgs, AVG(excess) AS mean_excess FROM above_baseline;

WITH telescope_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
overall_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT ta.avg_pulse
  FROM telescope_avgs ta, overall_avg_val oa
  WHERE ta.avg_pulse > oa.overall_avg
),
second_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as second_avg
  FROM above_overall
),
final_telescopes AS (
  SELECT aa.avg_pulse
  FROM above_overall aa, second_avg_val sa
  WHERE aa.avg_pulse > sa.second_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(ft.avg_pulse) as mean_avg_pulse,
  AVG(ft.avg_pulse - oa.overall_avg) as avg_above_overall,
  AVG(ft.avg_pulse - sa.second_avg) as avg_above_second
FROM final_telescopes ft, overall_avg_val oa, second_avg_val sa

WITH per_telescope_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
first_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as baseline1
  FROM per_telescope_avg
),
above_baseline1 AS (
  SELECT 
    pt.telescref,
    pt.avg_pulse_rate
  FROM per_telescope_avg pt
  CROSS JOIN first_baseline fb
  WHERE pt.avg_pulse_rate > fb.baseline1
),
second_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as baseline2
  FROM above_baseline1
),
final_telescopes AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.telescref,
    ab.avg_pulse_rate
  FROM above_baseline1 ab
  CROSS JOIN second_baseline sb
  WHERE ab.avg_pulse_rate > sb.baseline2
)
SELECT 
  AVG(ft.avg_pulse_rate) as mean_avg_pulse_rate,
  AVG(ft.avg_pulse_rate - fb.baseline1) as mean_excess_over_baseline1,
  AVG(ft.avg_pulse_rate - sb.baseline2) as mean_excess_over_baseline2
FROM final_telescopes ft
CROSS JOIN first_baseline fb
CROSS JOIN second_baseline sb

WITH total_attendance AS (

WITH execution_counts AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) as exec_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), total_executions AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM orderexecutions), execution_shares AS (SELECT ec.ordersmark, ec.exec_count, ec.exec_count::float / te.total as share, AVG(ec.exec_count::float / te.total) OVER () as avg_share FROM execution_counts ec CROSS JOIN total_executions te) SELECT ordersmark, exec_count, share, share - avg_share as share_diff FROM execution_shares ORDER BY ordersmark IS NULL, share_diff DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH total_count AS (

  GROUP BY ordersmark

avg_share_calc AS (

  FROM execution_stats
),
with_diff AS (

WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT SUM(Total) as customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), overall_stats AS (SELECT SUM(customer_total) as overall_sum, COUNT(*) as customer_count FROM customer_totals), shares_with_threshold AS (SELECT ct.customer_total, ct.customer_total / os.overall_sum as share, 1.0 / os.customer_count as avg_threshold FROM customer_totals ct CROSS JOIN overall_stats os), above_average AS (SELECT * FROM shares_with_threshold WHERE share > avg_threshold) SELECT AVG(customer_total) as avg_amount_spent, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share) - (SELECT 1.0 / customer_count FROM overall_stats) as avg_share_beat FROM above_average;

WITH feature_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    SUM(traitcount) as site_features
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
overall_stats AS (

    SUM(site_features) as total_features,
    COUNT(*) as site_count
  FROM feature_totals
),
shares_and_margins AS (
  SELECT 
    ft.zoneref,
    ft.site_features,
    ft.site_features * 1.0 / os.total_features as share,
    (ft.site_features * 1.0 / os.total_features) - (1.0 / os.site_count) as margin
  FROM feature_totals ft
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,

FROM shares_and_margins

WITH feature_records AS (

shares AS (

  FROM feature_records

ORDER BY margin DESC

WITH obs_telescope_counts AS (

),
totals AS (

    COUNT(*) as num_observatories,

),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    otc.observstation,
    otc.tele_count,
    CAST(otc.tele_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_telescopes as share,
    1.0 / t.num_observatories as avg_share,
    (CAST(otc.tele_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_telescopes) - (1.0 / t.num_observatories) as difference
  FROM obs_telescope_counts otc

WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total FROM telescope_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.observstation,
    tc.telescope_count,
    tc.telescope_count * 1.0 / t.total as share
  FROM telescope_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN total_count t
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg FROM shares
),
differences AS (
  SELECT 
    s.observstation,
    s.telescope_count,

    s.share - a.avg as difference,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.share - a.avg DESC) as rn
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN avg_share a
),
tenth_value AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT difference FROM differences WHERE rn = 10),
      (SELECT MIN(difference) FROM differences)
    ) as threshold
)
SELECT 
  observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share,
  difference
FROM differences
WHERE difference >= (SELECT threshold FROM tenth_value)
ORDER BY difference DESC;

WITH city_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        z.city,
        COUNT(*) as count
    FROM attendance a
    JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
    GROUP BY z.city
),
city_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        city,
        count,
        count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(count) FROM city_counts) as share
    FROM city_counts
),
avg_share_calc AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
    FROM city_shares
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.city,
        cs.count,
        cs.share,
        asc.avg_share,
        cs.share - asc.avg_share as above_avg
    FROM city_shares cs
    CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc
    WHERE cs.share > asc.avg_share
)
SELECT 
    AVG(count) as avg_count,
    AVG(share) as avg_share,
    AVG(above_avg) as avg_above_average
FROM above_average

deviations AS (
  SELECT

  FROM Examination e
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID

),
grouped_data AS (

  SELECT
    zoneref,

WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) as type_avg FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), overall_avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) as overall_avg FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL), kept_types AS (SELECT ta.production_type_code, ta.type_avg FROM type_averages ta CROSS JOIN overall_avg_cte WHERE ta.type_avg > overall_avg_cte.overall_avg), kept_mean_cte AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) as kept_mean FROM kept_types), final_types AS (SELECT kt.production_type_code, kt.type_avg FROM kept_types kt CROSS JOIN kept_mean_cte WHERE kt.type_avg > kept_mean_cte.kept_mean) SELECT AVG(ft.type_avg) as avg_type_price, AVG(ft.type_avg - oa.overall_avg) as avg_distance_from_overall, AVG(ft.type_avg - km.kept_mean) as avg_distance_from_kept_mean FROM final_types ft CROSS JOIN overall_avg_cte oa CROSS JOIN kept_mean_cte km

WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS baseline_price
  FROM Products
  WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    production_type_code,
    AVG(unit_price) AS type_avg_price
  FROM Products
  WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY production_type_code
),
above_baseline AS (
  SELECT 
    ta.production_type_code,
    ta.type_avg_price,
    b.baseline_price
  FROM type_averages ta
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE b.baseline_price IS NOT NULL
    AND ta.type_avg_price > b.baseline_price
),
mean_of_kept AS (
  SELECT AVG(type_avg_price) AS mean_price
  FROM above_baseline
),
final_kept AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.type_avg_price,
    ab.baseline_price,
    m.mean_price
  FROM above_baseline ab
  CROSS JOIN mean_of_kept m
  WHERE ab.type_avg_price > m.mean_price
)
SELECT 
  AVG(fk.type_avg_price) AS avg_type_price,
  AVG(fk.type_avg_price - fk.baseline_price) AS avg_above_baseline,
  AVG(fk.type_avg_price - fk.mean_price) AS avg_above_mean
FROM final_kept fk

WITH joined_data AS (
  SELECT tr.ordertypedist, tr.transreg
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT transreg) as distinct_trans_count
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(distinct_trans_count)::NUMERIC as total_trans
  FROM group_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    gc.ordertypedist,
    gc.distinct_trans_count,
    gc.distinct_trans_count::NUMERIC / t.total_trans as share
  FROM group_counts gc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as baseline_share FROM with_shares
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.ordertypedist,
    ws.distinct_trans_count,
    ws.share,
    ws.share - b.baseline_share as above_baseline
  FROM with_shares ws
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE ws.share > b.baseline_share
)
SELECT ordertypedist, distinct_trans_count, share, above_baseline
FROM filtered
ORDER BY ordertypedist;

  SELECT
    s.arcref,
    p.fundflux,
    SUM(s.gbsize) / SUM(s.spanmin) AS rate
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),

  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM group_rates
)
SELECT
  gr.arcref,
  gr.fundflux,
  gr.rate,
  gr.rate - b.avg_rate AS excess
FROM group_rates gr

WHERE gr.rate > b.avg_rate
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio

),
above_overall AS (

    pr.ratio,

  FROM patient_ratios pr
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa

),
group_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM above_overall
),
final_group AS (
  SELECT 
    ao.ratio,
    ao.above_overall_avg,
    (ao.ratio - ga.avg_ratio) as above_group_avg
  FROM above_overall ao
  CROSS JOIN group_avg ga
  WHERE ao.ratio > ga.avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(above_overall_avg) as avg_above_overall,
  AVG(above_group_avg) as avg_above_group
FROM final_group

first_filter AS (

    pr.ID,
    pr.ratio,
    pr.ratio - oa.avg_ratio as above_overall
  FROM patient_ratios pr
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE pr.ratio > oa.avg_ratio
),
second_group_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio_second
  FROM first_filter
),
second_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    ff.ID,
    ff.ratio,
    ff.above_overall,
    ff.ratio - sga.avg_ratio_second as above_second
  FROM first_filter ff
  CROSS JOIN second_group_avg sga
  WHERE ff.ratio > sga.avg_ratio_second

SELECT

  AVG(above_overall) as avg_above_overall,
