WITH event_groups AS (
  SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) as avg_analysts,
    AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) as avg_gap
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
overall_avg_gap AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gap) as overall_gap
  FROM event_groups
)
SELECT
  eg.corpeventprx,
  eg.avg_analysts,
  eg.avg_gap,
  eg.avg_gap - oag.overall_gap as gap_vs_overall
FROM event_groups eg
CROSS JOIN overall_avg_gap oag
WHERE oag.overall_gap IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY eg.corpeventprx NULLS FIRST;

WITH event_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) as avg_analyst_count,
    AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) as avg_ownership_diff
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_diff) as overall_diff_avg
  FROM event_groups
)
SELECT 
  eg.corpeventprx as event_type,
  eg.avg_analyst_count,
  eg.avg_ownership_diff,
  eg.avg_ownership_diff - oa.overall_diff_avg as diff_from_overall_avg
FROM event_groups eg
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE oa.overall_diff_avg IS NOT NULL;

WITH site_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(sm.facetfaces) as site_avg_faces
  FROM sites s
  INNER JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
),
overall_avg_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(sm.facetfaces) as overall_avg_faces
  FROM scanmesh sm
  WHERE sm.facetfaces IS NOT NULL
),
status_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.entrystat,
    AVG(sa.site_avg_faces) as status_avg_faces
  FROM site_avgs sa
  WHERE sa.entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sa.entrystat
),
focused_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.site_avg_faces,
    sta.status_avg_faces,
    oa.overall_avg_faces
  FROM site_avgs sa
  INNER JOIN status_avgs sta ON sa.entrystat = sta.entrystat
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_cte oa
  WHERE sa.site_avg_faces > sta.status_avg_faces
    AND oa.overall_avg_faces IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  AVG(fs.site_avg_faces) as avg_face_count,
  AVG(fs.site_avg_faces - fs.overall_avg_faces) as avg_above_overall,
  AVG(fs.site_avg_faces - fs.status_avg_faces) as avg_above_status
FROM focused_sites fs

WITH site_mesh_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(sm.facetfaces) as site_avg_faces
  FROM sites s
  LEFT JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
),
overall_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(site_avg_faces) as baseline
  FROM site_mesh_averages
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    sma.entrystat,
    AVG(sma.site_avg_faces) as status_avg
  FROM site_mesh_averages sma
  WHERE sma.entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sma.entrystat
),
kept_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sma.site_avg_faces,
    ob.baseline,
    sa.status_avg
  FROM site_mesh_averages sma
  CROSS JOIN overall_baseline ob
  JOIN status_averages sa ON sma.entrystat = sa.entrystat
  WHERE sma.entrystat IS NOT NULL
    AND sma.site_avg_faces > sa.status_avg
    AND ob.baseline IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  AVG(site_avg_faces) as avg_of_kept_sites,
  AVG(site_avg_faces - baseline) as avg_excess_over_baseline,
  AVG(site_avg_faces - status_avg) as avg_excess_over_status
FROM kept_sites

WITH race_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    r.name,
    AVG(ds.points) as avg_points,
    COUNT(*) as field_size
  FROM races r
  INNER JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(field_size) as overall_avg_field_size
  FROM race_stats
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT rs.avg_points, rs.field_size
  FROM race_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE rs.field_size > os.overall_avg_field_size
)
SELECT
  AVG(aa.avg_points) as avg_of_avg_points,
  AVG(aa.field_size) as avg_of_field_sizes,
  AVG(aa.field_size) - (SELECT overall_avg_field_size FROM overall_stats) as field_size_above_avg
FROM above_average aa

WITH race_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    r.name,
    AVG(ds.points) as avg_points,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) as driver_count
  FROM driverStandings ds
  INNER JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
overall_avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(driver_count) as avg_count
  FROM race_stats
),
filtered_races AS (
  SELECT rs.avg_points, rs.driver_count, oac.avg_count
  FROM race_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_count oac
  WHERE rs.driver_count > oac.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_points),
  AVG(driver_count),
  AVG(driver_count - avg_count)
FROM filtered_races

WITH grouped_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.translink,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) as count_records
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    translink,
    tradekind,
    count_records,
    CAST(count_records AS NUMERIC) / SUM(count_records) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) as share
  FROM grouped_counts
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(share) as avg_share_for_type
  FROM with_shares
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.translink,
    ws.tradekind,
    ws.count_records,
    ws.share,
    ta.avg_share_for_type
  FROM with_shares ws
  INNER JOIN type_averages ta ON ws.tradekind = ta.tradekind
  WHERE ws.share > ta.avg_share_for_type
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(count_records) as avg_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share) - MAX(avg_share_for_type) as avg_margin
FROM filtered
GROUP BY tradekind;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.translink,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) as pair_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind
),
with_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    b.translink,
    b.tradekind,
    b.pair_count,
    b.pair_count::NUMERIC / SUM(b.pair_count) OVER (PARTITION BY b.tradekind) as share
  FROM base b
),
with_avg_share AS (
  SELECT 
    wt.*,
    AVG(wt.share) OVER (PARTITION BY wt.tradekind) as avg_share_for_type
  FROM with_totals wt
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM with_avg_share
  WHERE share > avg_share_for_type
)
SELECT 
  f.tradekind,
  AVG(f.pair_count) as avg_record_count,
  AVG(f.share) as avg_share,
  AVG(f.share - f.avg_share_for_type) as avg_excess
FROM filtered f
GROUP BY f.tradekind
ORDER BY f.tradekind

WITH college_player_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.college_id,
    CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL OR c.state = '' THEN NULL ELSE c.state END AS state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count
  FROM college c
  INNER JOIN player_college pc ON c.college_id = pc.college_id
  GROUP BY c.college_id, CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL OR c.state = '' THEN NULL ELSE c.state END
),
global_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(player_count) AS global_avg,
    SUM(player_count) AS total_players
  FROM college_player_counts
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cpc.state, 'missing') AS state,
  AVG(cpc.player_count) AS avg_players_per_college,
  AVG(CAST(cpc.player_count AS FLOAT) / gs.global_avg) AS avg_relative_to_global,
  AVG(CAST(cpc.player_count AS FLOAT) / gs.total_players) AS avg_share_of_total
FROM college_player_counts cpc
CROSS JOIN global_stats gs
GROUP BY COALESCE(cpc.state, 'missing')
ORDER BY COALESCE(cpc.state, 'missing');

WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT c.college_id, c.state, COUNT(*) as player_year_count
  FROM player_college pc
  JOIN college c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id
  GROUP BY c.college_id, c.state
),
global_stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as global_total, AVG(player_year_count) as global_avg
  FROM college_counts
),
state_stats AS (
  SELECT cc.state,
    AVG(cc.player_year_count) as avg_college_count,
    AVG(cc.player_year_count / gs.global_avg) as avg_normalized_by_global_avg,
    AVG(cc.player_year_count / gs.global_total) as avg_share_of_total
  FROM college_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN global_stats gs
  GROUP BY cc.state
)
SELECT state, avg_college_count, avg_normalized_by_global_avg, avg_share_of_total
FROM state_stats
ORDER BY state

WITH regional_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    d.A3,
    COUNT(c.client_id) as client_count,
    COUNT(c.client_id) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(c.client_id)) OVER () as share
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM regional_shares
)
SELECT 
  SUM(rs.client_count) as total_clients,
  AVG(rs.share) as average_share,
  AVG(rs.share - asc.avg_share) as average_above_average
FROM regional_shares rs
CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc
WHERE rs.share > asc.avg_share

WITH region_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.A3 as region,
        COUNT(c.client_id) as client_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
total AS (
    SELECT SUM(client_count) as total_clients FROM region_counts
),
shares AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        client_count,
        client_count * 1.0 / (SELECT total_clients FROM total) as share
    FROM region_counts
),
avg_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) as avg FROM shares
)
SELECT 
    SUM(client_count) as total_count,
    AVG(share) as average_share,
    AVG(share - (SELECT avg FROM avg_share)) as avg_above_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT avg FROM avg_share)

    p.death_country,
    AVG(pav.points_won) as avg_points
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.death_country
),
simple_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_points) as overall_avg
  FROM country_averages
)
SELECT 
  ca.death_country,
  ca.avg_points,
  ca.avg_points - sa.overall_avg as distance_from_avg
FROM country_averages ca
CROSS JOIN simple_average sa
ORDER BY ca.death_country;

  SELECT 
    p.death_country,
    pav.points_won
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  INNER JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country != ''
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    death_country,
    AVG(points_won) as avg_points_won
  FROM player_votes
  GROUP BY death_country

ORDER BY acctscope, rank;

WITH winners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ma.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '(blank)') AS bats
  FROM manager_award ma
  JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
),
by_hand AS (
  SELECT bats, COUNT(*) AS managers
  FROM winners
  GROUP BY bats
)
SELECT bats,
       managers,
       1.0 * managers / (SELECT SUM(managers) FROM by_hand) AS share
FROM by_hand
ORDER BY managers DESC, bats;

WITH color_counts AS (SELECT p.product_color AS color, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_items, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM color_counts), kept AS (SELECT cc.color, cc.cnt, 1.0 * cc.cnt / t.total_items AS share, cc.cnt - t.avg_cnt AS excess FROM color_counts cc CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE cc.cnt > t.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM kept;

WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_paid FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), store_avg AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(total_paid) AS avg_total FROM rental_totals GROUP BY store_id) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.total_paid) AS total_paid_sum, AVG(rt.total_paid - sa.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM rental_totals rt JOIN store_avg sa ON sa.store_id = rt.store_id WHERE rt.total_paid > sa.avg_total GROUP BY rt.store_id ORDER BY rt.store_id;

WITH grouped AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id AS order_item_id, p.product_color AS product_color, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color), ranked AS (SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC NULLS LAST) AS quantity_rank FROM grouped) SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, quantity_rank FROM ranked WHERE quantity_rank <= 3;

WITH signed AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, CASE t.type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END AS signed_amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id), region_stats AS (SELECT region, AVG(signed_amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM signed GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg FROM region_stats), selected AS (SELECT r.region, r.avg_amount, r.txn_count FROM region_stats r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.avg_amount > o.mean_avg) SELECT AVG(s.avg_amount) AS mean_of_region_avgs, AVG(s.txn_count) AS mean_of_txn_counts, AVG(s.avg_amount - o.mean_avg) AS mean_excess_over_cross_mean FROM selected s CROSS JOIN overall o;

WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, avg_per_day_price, avg_per_day_price / (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_price) FROM per_rating) AS ratio_to_rating_mean FROM per_rating ORDER BY rating;

WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM album_stats), above AS (SELECT a.rate, a.track_count, a.rate - o.mean_rate AS excess FROM album_stats a CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE a.rate > o.mean_rate) SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM above;

WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name AS event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per_name) SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall, p.avg_amount / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg;

WITH event_ratio AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_spend_ratio FROM event_ratio) SELECT e.event_id, e.spend_ratio, e.spend_ratio / a.avg_spend_ratio AS relative_spend_ratio FROM event_ratio e CROSS JOIN avg_ratio a ORDER BY relative_spend_ratio IS NULL, relative_spend_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH groups AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM groups), shares AS (SELECT g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / s.total_cnt AS share, s.avg_cnt FROM groups g CROSS JOIN stats s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_invoices, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_count FROM shares WHERE cnt > avg_cnt;

WITH inv_avg AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) AS overall_avg FROM inv_avg), dev AS (SELECT ia.InvoiceId, ia.Country, ia.avg_unit_price, ia.avg_unit_price - o.overall_avg AS deviation FROM inv_avg ia CROSS JOIN overall o) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS deviation_minus_country_avg FROM dev ORDER BY deviation_minus_country_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt FROM telescopes
),
grp AS (
  SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
shares AS (
  SELECT g.powerstatus, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total_cnt AS share
  FROM grp g
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
avg_s AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
),
above AS (
  SELECT s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN avg_s a
  WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
)
SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_telescopes,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_above_mean
FROM above;

WITH gender_counts AS (
  SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM Invoices i
  JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
shares AS (
  SELECT gender, order_count, CAST(order_count AS REAL) / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM gender_counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.gender, s.order_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;

WITH status_avgs AS (
  SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL AND t.equipstatus IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.equipstatus
),
m1 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean1 FROM status_avgs
),
kept1 AS (
  SELECT a.equipstatus, a.avg_pulse, a.avg_pulse - m1.mean1 AS excess1
  FROM status_avgs a
  CROSS JOIN m1
  WHERE a.avg_pulse > m1.mean1
),
m2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean2 FROM kept1
),
kept2 AS (
  SELECT k.equipstatus, k.avg_pulse, k.excess1, k.avg_pulse - m2.mean2 AS excess2
  FROM kept1 k
  CROSS JOIN m2
  WHERE k.avg_pulse > m2.mean2
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS avg_pulse_average,
       AVG(excess1) AS avg_excess_over_mean1,
       AVG(excess2) AS avg_excess_over_mean2
FROM kept2;

WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS account_sum, COUNT(*) AS trans_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), ranked AS (SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, trans_count, 1.0 * account_sum / NULLIF(SUM(account_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 0) AS share FROM acct) SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, trans_count, share FROM ranked ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH g AS (SELECT o.timespan AS tif, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS ord_cnt FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), stats AS (SELECT AVG(ord_cnt) AS mean_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(g.ord_cnt) AS total_distinct_orders, AVG(g.ord_cnt - s.mean_cnt) AS avg_excess_count FROM g CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE g.ord_cnt > s.mean_cnt;

WITH standings AS (
  SELECT ci.country, cs.wins
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE ci.country IS NOT NULL
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM standings
  GROUP BY country
),
mean_all AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m FROM country_avg
),
above_all AS (
  SELECT c.country, c.avg_wins
  FROM country_avg c, mean_all
  WHERE c.avg_wins > mean_all.m
),
mean_above AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m FROM above_all
),
final AS (
  SELECT a.country, a.avg_wins
  FROM above_all a, mean_above
  WHERE a.avg_wins > mean_above.m
)
SELECT
  AVG(f.avg_wins) AS mean_final_avg_wins,
  AVG(f.avg_wins - mean_all.m) AS mean_excess_over_all_mean,
  AVG(f.avg_wins - mean_above.m) AS mean_excess_over_above_mean
FROM final f, mean_all, mean_above;

WITH rep_counts AS (
  SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City AS City, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM Customer c
  JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
  GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City
),
city_avg AS (
  SELECT City, AVG(cnt) AS city_avg_cnt
  FROM rep_counts
  GROUP BY City
),
above AS (
  SELECT r.EmployeeId, r.City, r.cnt, a.city_avg_cnt
  FROM rep_counts r
  JOIN city_avg a ON a.City IS r.City
  WHERE r.cnt > a.city_avg_cnt
),
kept_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM above
)
SELECT ab.City AS city,
  SUM(ab.cnt) AS total_customers,
  AVG(ab.cnt - ab.city_avg_cnt) AS avg_excess,
  AVG(ab.cnt * 1.0 / kt.total) AS avg_share
FROM above ab
CROSS JOIN kept_total kt
GROUP BY ab.City;

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, s.shortintrt, s.optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref
),
tx AS (
  SELECT transreg, ordertypedist,
         AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_shortintrt,
         AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS base_shortintrt
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT tx.transreg AS transref,
       tx.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
       tx.avg_shortintrt,
       tx.avg_optvolrt,
       tx.avg_shortintrt / NULLIF(b.base_shortintrt, 0) AS short_interest_ratio
FROM tx
JOIN baseline b ON b.ordertypedist IS NOT DISTINCT FROM tx.ordertypedist
ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH line_totals AS (
  SELECT b.budget_id,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total,
         COUNT(e.expense_id) AS n
  FROM budget b
  LEFT JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  GROUP BY b.budget_id
),
avg_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM line_totals
),
above AS (
  SELECT lt.total, lt.n, at.avg_total
  FROM line_totals lt
  CROSS JOIN avg_total at
  WHERE lt.total > at.avg_total
)
SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_above_total,
       SUM(n) AS total_expenses,
       AVG(total - avg_total) AS avg_excess_over_average
FROM above;
SELECT t.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS ratio FROM Track t GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH fielders AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(DISTINCT f.player_id) AS cnt FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM fielders) SELECT f.bats, f.cnt, f.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share, f.cnt - t.avg_cnt AS above_avg FROM fielders f CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE f.cnt > t.avg_cnt;

WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(address_count) AS total_addresses, COUNT(*) AS num_cities FROM city_counts), metrics AS (SELECT cc.city_id, cc.address_count, CAST(cc.address_count AS DOUBLE) / (CAST(t.total_addresses AS DOUBLE) / t.num_cities) AS count_vs_avg, CAST(cc.address_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(t.total_addresses AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM city_counts cc CROSS JOIN totals t), ranked AS (SELECT m.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY m.share DESC) AS share_rank FROM metrics m) SELECT city_id, address_count, count_vs_avg, share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, city_id

WITH scan_rates AS (SELECT crewref, scancount, gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0) AS gb_per_min FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL), op_stats AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scan_rates WHERE gb_per_min IS NOT NULL GROUP BY crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS overall_avg FROM op_stats), qualified AS (SELECT o.total_scans, o.avg_gb_per_min FROM op_stats o CROSS JOIN overall v WHERE o.avg_gb_per_min > v.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(q.total_scans) AS avg_total_scans, AVG(q.avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(q.avg_gb_per_min - v.overall_avg) AS avg_margin_above_overall FROM qualified q CROSS JOIN overall v;

SELECT p.bats AS bats,
       COUNT(*) AS appearance_count,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg_group_count
FROM appearances a
JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.bats;

WITH matched AS (SELECT s.entrystat, e.ambictemp, e.imgcount FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(imgcount) AS avg_imgcount_all FROM matched) SELECT m.entrystat, AVG(m.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(m.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount, AVG(m.imgcount) - o.avg_imgcount_all AS imgcount_diff_from_overall FROM matched m CROSS JOIN overall o GROUP BY m.entrystat, o.avg_imgcount_all;

WITH rates AS (SELECT mt.Name AS MediaTypeName, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS ByteRate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(ByteRate) AS AvgRate FROM rates) SELECT r.MediaTypeName, r.ByteRate, r.ByteRate - a.AvgRate AS AboveAverageBy FROM rates r CROSS JOIN avg_rate a WHERE r.ByteRate > a.AvgRate ORDER BY r.ByteRate DESC;

WITH tc AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), tot AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM telescopes), sh AS (SELECT tc.observstation, tc.telescope_count, tc.telescope_count * 1.0 / tot.total AS share FROM tc CROSS JOIN tot), avg_sh AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh), above AS (SELECT sh.observstation, sh.telescope_count, sh.share, sh.share - avg_sh.avg_share AS diff_above_avg FROM sh CROSS JOIN avg_sh WHERE sh.share > avg_sh.avg_share), ranked AS (SELECT above.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC) AS rk FROM above) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, diff_above_avg FROM ranked WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC;

WITH proj_ratio AS (
  SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id,
         p.fundflux AS funding_source,
         SUM(s.boxx) / NULLIF(SUM(s.boxz), 0) AS ratio
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT project_id,
         funding_source,
         ratio,
         ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS excess
  FROM proj_ratio
)
SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, excess
FROM ranked
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH race_totals AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), kept AS (SELECT race_name, total_points FROM race_totals WHERE total_points > (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_totals)), kept_laps AS (SELECT CAST(res.laps AS REAL) AS laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId JOIN kept k ON k.race_name = r.name WHERE res.laps GLOB '[0-9]*') SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_points) FROM kept) AS sum_kept_total_points, (SELECT AVG(laps) FROM kept_laps) AS avg_laps, (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM kept) - (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_totals) AS avg_excess_over_mean_total

WITH site_stats AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS site_ratio FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat HAVING AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) IS NOT NULL), status_avg AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) AS status_ratio FROM site_stats GROUP BY insurstat), kept AS (SELECT ss.insurstat, ss.site_ratio, ss.mesh_count, sa.status_ratio FROM site_stats ss JOIN status_avg sa ON sa.insurstat = ss.insurstat WHERE ss.site_ratio > sa.status_ratio) SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, SUM(mesh_count) AS total_mesh_records, AVG(site_ratio - status_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_status FROM kept GROUP BY insurstat;

WITH lab_pt AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(CASE WHEN l.ALB IS NOT NULL AND l.TP IS NOT NULL THEN l.ALB - l.TP END) AS alb_tp, AVG(CASE WHEN l.APTT IS NOT NULL AND l.PT IS NOT NULL THEN l.APTT - l.PT END) AS aptt_pt FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_avg AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_tp) AS alb_tp, AVG(aptt_pt) AS aptt_pt FROM lab_pt GROUP BY SEX), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(aptt_pt) AS mean_aptt_pt FROM sex_avg), kept AS (SELECT s.* FROM sex_avg s, threshold t WHERE s.aptt_pt > t.mean_aptt_pt) SELECT AVG(alb_tp) AS alb_tp_figure, AVG(aptt_pt) AS aptt_pt_figure, AVG(aptt_pt) - (SELECT mean_aptt_pt FROM threshold) AS aptt_pt_excess FROM kept;

WITH acct_vol AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_volume, COUNT(*) AS num_transactions FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, total_volume, num_transactions, CAST(total_volume AS REAL) / SUM(total_volume) OVER () AS share FROM acct_vol ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH cust_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_orders FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.gender) <> '' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), gender_totals AS (SELECT gender, SUM(num_orders) AS gender_orders FROM cust_orders GROUP BY gender), shares AS (SELECT co.customer_id, co.gender, co.num_orders, CAST(co.num_orders AS REAL) / gt.gender_orders AS share FROM cust_orders co JOIN gender_totals gt ON gt.gender = co.gender), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.customer_id, s.gender, s.num_orders, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS gap_above_avg FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY gap_above_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH unit AS (SELECT zoneref AS site_code, SUM(articount) AS artifact_count FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY zoneref), tot AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS overall_total FROM scanfeatures), shares AS (SELECT u.site_code, u.artifact_count, CAST(u.artifact_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.overall_total, 0) AS share FROM unit u CROSS JOIN tot t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.site_code, s.artifact_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_diff FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_diff IS NULL, share_diff DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS cnt FROM constructors c JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM counts) SELECT counts.constructorId, counts.nationality, counts.cnt, counts.cnt - avg_c.avg_cnt AS diff FROM counts CROSS JOIN avg_c WHERE counts.cnt - avg_c.avg_cnt > 0 ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS mean_per_day FROM rating_stats), above AS (SELECT rs.avg_length, rs.per_day_price, rs.per_day_price - o.mean_per_day AS excess FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rs.per_day_price > o.mean_per_day) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length, AVG(per_day_price) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM above;

SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(l.RBC) AS avg_rbc, AVG(l.GOT) - o.overall_got AS got_diff FROM Laboratory l CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(GOT) AS overall_got FROM Laboratory) o WHERE o.overall_got IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.ID, o.overall_got ORDER BY got_diff IS NULL, got_diff DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH owner_pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, d.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
dist_counts AS (
  SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM owner_pairs
  GROUP BY district_id
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM dist_counts
)
SELECT ds.A3 AS region,
       AVG(dc.cnt) AS avg_clients_per_district,
       AVG(1.0 * dc.cnt / t.total_cnt) AS avg_client_share
FROM dist_counts dc
JOIN district ds ON ds.district_id = dc.district_id
CROSS JOIN total t
GROUP BY ds.A3;

WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws AS hand, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS cnt FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), shares AS (SELECT hand, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, a.avg_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM kept;

WITH counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(account_count) AS total_accounts FROM counts), shares AS (SELECT c.district_id, c.account_count, CAST(c.account_count AS REAL) / t.total_accounts AS share FROM counts c CROSS JOIN totals t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), diffs AS (SELECT s.district_id, s.account_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_diff FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a), ranked AS (SELECT d.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.share_diff DESC) AS rnk FROM diffs d) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share_diff FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY share_diff DESC;

WITH acct_region AS (SELECT o.account_id, d3.A3 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM `order` o JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = o.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN district d3 ON d3.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d3.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM acct_region), diffs AS (SELECT ar.account_id, ar.region, ar.order_count, ar.order_count - (SELECT avg_count FROM overall) AS diff FROM acct_region ar), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(diff) AS region_avg_diff FROM diffs GROUP BY region) SELECT df.account_id, df.region, df.order_count, df.diff, df.diff - ra.region_avg_diff AS excess_over_region_avg FROM diffs df JOIN region_avg ra ON ra.region = df.region WHERE df.diff > ra.region_avg_diff ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH line AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, b.remaining, (b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount AS overspend FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event), ev AS (SELECT event_id, status, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(overspend) AS avg_overspend FROM line GROUP BY event_id, status), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS mean_ev_remaining FROM ev) SELECT ev.status, AVG(ev.avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(ev.avg_overspend) AS avg_overspend_rate, AVG(ev.avg_remaining) / (SELECT mean_ev_remaining FROM overall) AS remaining_ratio FROM ev GROUP BY ev.status;

WITH valid AS (SELECT t.tradekind, ab.abhvreg FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL), counts AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM valid GROUP BY tradekind), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM counts), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM counts), above AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, s.cnt - st.avg_cnt AS excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE s.cnt > st.avg_cnt) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS sum_counts, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM above

WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM per_account) SELECT p.account_id, p.avg_amount, p.n, CAST(p.n AS REAL) / o.avg_n AS ratio FROM per_account p CROSS JOIN overall o ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

  SELECT bats_group AS bats, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_count
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY bats_group
),
totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS total_players FROM joined
),
shares AS (
  SELECT h.bats, h.player_count, h.player_count * 1.0 / t.total_players AS share
  FROM hand_counts h
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.bats, s.player_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS above_average_by
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
ORDER BY s.share DESC;

WITH cc AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM cc), above AS (SELECT cc.cnt FROM cc, stats WHERE cc.cnt > stats.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(above.cnt) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(above.cnt * 1.0 / stats.total_cnt) AS avg_share_of_total, AVG(above.cnt - stats.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM above, stats

WITH order_counts AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices GROUP BY order_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices FROM order_counts), shares AS (SELECT oc.order_id, oc.invoice_count, 1.0 * oc.invoice_count / t.total_invoices AS share FROM order_counts oc CROSS JOIN totals t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.invoice_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(excess) AS average_excess_over_mean FROM above;

WITH acct AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, a.account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS avg_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3, a.account_id), region AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) AS amount_avg, AVG(avg_balance) AS balance_avg FROM acct GROUP BY region) SELECT region, amount_avg, balance_avg, amount_avg / (SELECT AVG(amount_avg) FROM region) AS amount_ratio FROM region WHERE (SELECT AVG(amount_avg) FROM region) IS NOT NULL

WITH player_avg AS (SELECT bp.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp."double") AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats HAVING AVG(bp."double") IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) AS overall_avg FROM player_avg), indexed AS (SELECT pa.player_id, pa.bats, pa.avg_doubles, pa.avg_doubles / o.overall_avg AS idx FROM player_avg pa CROSS JOIN overall o), hand_avg AS (SELECT bats, AVG(idx) AS hand_idx FROM indexed GROUP BY bats) SELECT i.player_id, i.bats AS batting_hand, i.avg_doubles, i.idx AS index_value, i.idx - h.hand_idx AS index_minus_hand_avg FROM indexed i JOIN hand_avg h ON h.bats = i.bats WHERE i.bats IS NOT NULL ORDER BY index_minus_hand_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH per_account AS (SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), freq_avg AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(avg_amount) AS freq_avg FROM per_account GROUP BY frequency) SELECT p.account_id, p.frequency, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount / f.freq_avg AS ratio FROM per_account p JOIN freq_avg f ON f.frequency = p.frequency ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH spatial AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux,
         (CAST(s.boxy AS DOUBLE PRECISION) - CAST(s.boxx AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) / NULLIF(CAST(s.boxx AS DOUBLE PRECISION), 0) AS yx_diff,
         CAST(s.aream2 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(CAST(s.volm3 AS DOUBLE PRECISION), 0) AS atv
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL
),
per_source AS (
  SELECT fundflux,
         AVG(yx_diff) AS avg_yx_diff,
         AVG(atv) AS avg_atv
  FROM spatial
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_atv) AS cross_avg
  FROM per_source
)
SELECT ps.fundflux,
       ps.avg_yx_diff,
       ps.avg_atv,
       ps.avg_atv - o.cross_avg AS above_cross_avg_by
FROM per_source ps
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE ps.avg_atv > o.cross_avg;

WITH per_status AS (SELECT e.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status) SELECT status, attendance_count, CAST(attendance_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(attendance_count) FROM per_status) AS share FROM per_status;

WITH site_counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), shares AS (SELECT healtheval, site_count, site_count * 1.0 / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM site_counts), ranked AS (SELECT healtheval, site_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(site_count) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM ranked WHERE share > avg_share;

WITH qty AS (SELECT order_id, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL) AS q FROM Order_Items), per_order AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(q) AS avg_qty FROM qty WHERE q IS NOT NULL GROUP BY order_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS base FROM per_order) SELECT p.order_id, p.avg_qty AS avg_quantity, p.avg_qty - b.base AS diff_from_baseline FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_qty - b.base IS NULL), (p.avg_qty - b.base) DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH joined AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, t.observstation, t.bandusagepct FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), station_stats AS (SELECT lunarstage, observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg, COUNT(*) AS n FROM joined GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandusagepct, SUM(n) AS telescope_count, CAST(SUM(n) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM joined) AS telescope_fraction FROM station_stats GROUP BY lunarstage;

WITH per_account AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
  FROM `order`
  GROUP BY account_id
),
avg_orders AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM per_account
)
SELECT pa.account_id,
       d.A3 AS region,
       pa.order_cnt,
       pa.order_cnt - a.avg_cnt AS diff
FROM per_account pa
JOIN account ac ON ac.account_id = pa.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ac.district_id
CROSS JOIN avg_orders a
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH rating_avg AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS base FROM rating_avg), above_baseline AS (SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_length FROM rating_avg ra CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE ra.avg_length > b.base), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS kept_avg FROM above_baseline), final AS (SELECT ab.rating, ab.avg_length FROM above_baseline ab CROSS JOIN kept_mean k WHERE ab.avg_length > k.kept_avg) SELECT AVG(f.avg_length) AS mean_avg_length, AVG(f.avg_length - b.base) AS mean_excess_over_baseline, AVG(f.avg_length - k.kept_avg) AS mean_excess_over_kept_mean FROM final f CROSS JOIN baseline b CROSS JOIN kept_mean k;

SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.death_country) AS share FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country <> '' GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST, manager_id LIMIT 10;

WITH item_town AS (
  SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city AS town,
         AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(CAST(ili.derived_product_cost AS REAL) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
  JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_avg AS (
  SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_ratio FROM town_avg
)
SELECT t.town, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio AS ratio_excess
FROM town_avg t
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE t.avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio;

WITH mt_stats AS (SELECT mt.Name AS media_type, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS overall_rate FROM mt_stats), above AS (SELECT s.byte_rate, s.track_count, s.byte_rate - o.overall_rate AS excess FROM mt_stats s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.byte_rate > o.overall_rate) SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_rate FROM above;

WITH g AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS EmployeeCount
  FROM Employee
  GROUP BY ReportsTo
),
s AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo, EmployeeCount,
         EmployeeCount * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(EmployeeCount) FROM g) AS Share
  FROM g
)
SELECT ReportsTo, EmployeeCount, Share,
       Share - (SELECT AVG(Share) FROM s) AS ShareDiff
FROM s
ORDER BY ShareDiff DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH per_type AS (SELECT tr.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM transactionrecord t JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY tr.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM per_type) SELECT p.trader_type, p.cnt AS count, 1.0 * p.cnt / s.total_cnt AS share, p.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS diff_from_avg FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE p.cnt > s.avg_cnt;

SELECT c.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS record_fraction FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY record_fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, CAST(AVG(rental_rate) AS DOUBLE) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS threshold FROM per_rating), above AS (SELECT p.per_day, p.per_day - o.threshold AS excess FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.per_day > o.threshold) SELECT AVG(per_day) AS avg_per_day_above, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_above FROM above;

WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin rm JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.ordertune IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ordertune), avg_cnt AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(tc.cnt) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(tc.cnt - ac.avg_count) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM type_counts tc CROSS JOIN avg_cnt ac WHERE tc.cnt > ac.avg_count;

WITH group_avgs AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), valid AS (SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex FROM group_avgs WHERE avg_modindex IS NOT NULL), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS base FROM valid), kept AS (SELECT v.rfistat, v.avg_modindex, v.avg_modindex - b.base AS above_baseline FROM valid v CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE v.avg_modindex > b.base), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS km FROM kept) SELECT k.rfistat, k.avg_modindex, k.above_baseline, ABS(k.avg_modindex - m.km) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m;

WITH joined AS (
  SELECT e.ordersmark, o.timespan, e.fillcount,
    AVG(e.fillcount) OVER (PARTITION BY o.timespan) AS tif_fill
  FROM orderexecutions e
  JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
),
order_avg AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, timespan, MAX(tif_fill) AS tif_fill, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY ordersmark, timespan
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, tif_fill,
    avg_fill - tif_fill AS excess,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank
  FROM order_avg
)
SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, excess, fill_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE avg_fill > tif_fill AND fill_rank <= 3
ORDER BY timespan, fill_rank, ordersmark;

WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '(blank)') AS hand, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_id) AS cnt FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY 1), shares AS (SELECT hand, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_mean_share FROM kept;

WITH groups AS (SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), totals AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_members, AVG(member_count) AS avg_per_group FROM groups) SELECT g.major_id, g.member_count, 1.0 * g.member_count / t.total_members AS share_of_total, g.member_count / t.avg_per_group AS ratio_to_avg_group FROM groups AS g CROSS JOIN totals AS t ORDER BY ratio_to_avg_group DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH per_sex AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT sex, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM per_sex) AS ana_ratio FROM per_sex;

WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), totals AS (SELECT SUM(race_count) AS total_races FROM circuit_counts), shares AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, CAST(c.race_count AS REAL) / t.total_races AS share FROM circuit_counts c CROSS JOIN totals t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.circuitId, s.race_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH gains AS (SELECT ds.raceId, r.circuitId, ds.wins - LAG(ds.wins, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.driverId, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS gain FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId), per_race AS (SELECT g.raceId, c.country, AVG(g.gain) AS race_avg FROM gains g JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = g.circuitId GROUP BY g.raceId, c.country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_avg) AS avg_wins FROM per_race GROUP BY country), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS bench FROM country_avg), kept AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_avg ca, benchmark b WHERE ca.avg_wins > b.bench), second AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m2 FROM kept), final AS (SELECT k.country, k.avg_wins FROM kept k, second s WHERE k.avg_wins > s.m2) SELECT f.country, f.avg_wins AS average, f.avg_wins - b.bench AS above_benchmark, f.avg_wins - s.m2 AS above_second_mean FROM final f, benchmark b, second s ORDER BY f.country;

WITH snap AS (
  SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) AS own
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref
  WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist
),
units AS (
  SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, own,
    AVG(own) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mix_base,
    AVG(own) OVER () AS overall
  FROM snap
  WHERE own IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
  SELECT * FROM units WHERE own > overall
)
SELECT AVG(own) AS avg_kept_ownership,
  AVG(own / mix_base) AS avg_ratio_to_mix_baseline,
  AVG(own - overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall
FROM kept;

WITH joined AS (
  SELECT o.recordvault AS ordervault, o.orderflow, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.orderflow
),
shares AS (
  SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt,
         cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share
  FROM joined
),
diffs AS (
  SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share_minus_avg
  FROM shares
),
above AS (
  SELECT * FROM diffs WHERE share_minus_avg > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC) AS rk FROM above
)
SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt AS record_count, share, share_minus_avg
FROM ranked
WHERE rk <= 10
ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC;

WITH dept_counts AS (
  SELECT m.department AS department, COUNT(mem.member_id) AS member_count
  FROM member mem
  JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
  GROUP BY m.department
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total FROM dept_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT d.department, d.member_count, CAST(d.member_count AS REAL) / t.total AS share
  FROM dept_counts d
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.department, s.member_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share >= a.avg_share;

WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_count) AS avg_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.invoice_count) AS avg_invoice_count_above_average, AVG(g.invoice_count - o.avg_count) AS avg_excess_over_overall_average FROM gender_counts g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.invoice_count > o.avg_count;

WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS DOUBLE) / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS films FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_ratio, films, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_rating) AS diff_from_plain_avg FROM per_rating ORDER BY rating;

WITH joined AS (SELECT p.fundflux FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref), grp AS (SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM joined GROUP BY fundflux), tot AS (SELECT SUM(qc_count) AS total_qc, AVG(qc_count) AS avg_per_group FROM grp) SELECT g.fundflux, g.qc_count, g.qc_count * 1.0 / t.total_qc AS share_of_total, g.qc_count * 1.0 / t.avg_per_group AS ratio_to_average FROM grp g CROSS JOIN tot t ORDER BY g.qc_count DESC, g.fundflux

WITH tel_avg AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg
  FROM tel_avg
)
SELECT t.telescref,
       t.avg_modindex,
       t.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall,
       t.avg_modindex / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall
FROM tel_avg t
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE t.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY ratio_to_overall DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS base_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
combo AS (
  SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS combo_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref
  JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = t.trdref
  GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind
),
dev AS (
  SELECT c.transref, c.tradekind, c.combo_avg, c.combo_avg - b.base_avg AS deviation
  FROM combo c
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE b.base_avg IS NOT NULL
),
type_dev AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS type_avg_dev
  FROM dev
  WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
kept AS (
  SELECT d.tradekind, d.combo_avg, d.deviation, d.deviation - td.type_avg_dev AS excess
  FROM dev d
  JOIN type_dev td ON td.tradekind = d.tradekind
  WHERE d.deviation > td.type_avg_dev
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(combo_avg) AS avg_optvolrt,
       AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM kept
GROUP BY tradekind
ORDER BY tradekind;

WITH scan_rates AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, sc.scancount, sc.gbsize::double precision / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)::double precision AS gb_per_min
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
status_rates AS (
  SELECT healtheval AS status, SUM(scancount) AS total_scancount, AVG(gb_per_min) AS rate
  FROM scan_rates
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM status_rates
)
SELECT r.status, r.total_scancount, r.rate, r.rate - o.avg_rate AS rate_minus_avg
FROM status_rates r
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE r.rate > o.avg_rate

WITH film_copies AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating), stats AS (SELECT film_id, rating, copies, AVG(copies) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS rating_avg_copies, AVG(copies) OVER () AS overall_avg_copies FROM film_copies) SELECT film_id, rating, copies, copies - rating_avg_copies AS diff_from_rating_avg, copies - overall_avg_copies AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM stats ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH units AS (SELECT product_id, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(TRIM(product_quantity) AS INTEGER)), 0) AS units FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), shares AS (SELECT product_id, units, units * 1.0 / SUM(units) OVER () AS share FROM units), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.product_id, s.units, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(units) AS combined_units, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(excess) AS average_excess_over_overall_avg FROM above;

WITH joined AS (SELECT t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), counts AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM joined GROUP BY tradekind), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt::double precision / (SUM(cnt) OVER ())::double precision AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares) SELECT s.tradekind, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_s AS share_minus_avg FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_s;

WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT orderslink,
         AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal,
         AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_rate
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
bench AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_rate) AS benchmark
  FROM per_order
),
above AS (
  SELECT p.avg_rebtotal, p.avg_net_rate, b.benchmark
  FROM per_order p
  CROSS JOIN bench b
  WHERE p.avg_net_rate > b.benchmark
)
SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS avg_of_avg_rebtotal,
       AVG(avg_net_rate) AS avg_of_avg_net_rate,
       AVG(avg_net_rate - benchmark) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark
FROM above;

WITH linked AS (

WITH ratios AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / l.GPT AS ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID), valid AS (SELECT sex, ratio FROM ratios WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL), grp AS (SELECT sex, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM valid GROUP BY sex), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean1 FROM grp), kept1 AS (SELECT g.sex, g.avg_ratio FROM grp AS g, m1 WHERE g.avg_ratio > m1.mean1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean2 FROM kept1), kept2 AS (SELECT k.avg_ratio, m1.mean1, m2.mean2 FROM kept1 AS k, m1, m2 WHERE k.avg_ratio > m2.mean2) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_kept_group_averages, AVG(avg_ratio - mean1) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(avg_ratio - mean2) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM kept2;

WITH dc AS (

WITH scope_fees AS (

WITH matched AS (SELECT o.timespan AS bucket, r.riskandmarginpivot FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault), buckets AS (SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM matched GROUP BY bucket), shares AS (SELECT bucket, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM buckets), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(k.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(k.share) AS avg_kept_share, AVG(k.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_share FROM kept k CROSS JOIN avg_share a;

WITH counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, 100.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share_pct, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_mean_share FROM above;

WITH txn AS (SELECT ft.transaction_amount AS amt, c.state_county_province AS state FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = ft.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id), state_totals AS (SELECT state, COALESCE(SUM(amt), 0) AS total FROM txn GROUP BY state), shares AS (SELECT state, total, total * 1.0 / SUM(total) OVER () AS share FROM state_totals), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.total) AS combined_total, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_over_avg_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;

WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, CAST(AVG(rental_rate) AS DOUBLE) / AVG(rental_duration) AS daily_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), cross_avg AS (SELECT AVG(daily_price) AS avg_daily_price FROM rating_stats), kept AS (SELECT rs.avg_replacement_cost, rs.daily_price, ca.avg_daily_price AS threshold FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN cross_avg ca WHERE rs.daily_price > ca.avg_daily_price) SELECT AVG(avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_of_avg_replacement_cost, AVG(daily_price) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(daily_price - threshold) AS avg_excess_over_cross_avg FROM kept;

WITH matched AS (

WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM address), ranked AS (SELECT c.city_id, c.address_count, CAST(c.address_count AS DOUBLE) / t.n AS fraction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.address_count DESC) AS rnk FROM city_counts c CROSS JOIN total t) SELECT city_id, address_count, fraction FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY fraction DESC, city_id

WITH matched AS (SELECT p.fundflux FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL), per_source AS (SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM matched GROUP BY fundflux), stats AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM per_source) SELECT ps.fundflux, ps.cnt AS count, ps.cnt::numeric / st.total_cnt AS share, ps.cnt - st.avg_cnt AS exceeds_avg_by FROM per_source ps CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE ps.cnt > st.avg_cnt;

WITH acct_avg AS (

WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), s AS (SELECT g.ID, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share FROM g, t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(k.cnt) AS avg_record_count, AVG(k.share) AS avg_share, AVG(k.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_share_excess FROM k, a;

WITH base AS (

WITH order_avg AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), bench1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS b1 FROM order_avg), kept1 AS (SELECT o.ordersmark, o.avg_fill, o.avg_fill - b.b1 AS excess1 FROM order_avg o CROSS JOIN bench1 b WHERE o.avg_fill > b.b1), bench2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS b2 FROM kept1), final AS (SELECT k.ordersmark, k.avg_fill, k.excess1, k.avg_fill - b.b2 AS excess2 FROM kept1 k CROSS JOIN bench2 b WHERE k.avg_fill > b.b2) SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_fill_final, AVG(excess1) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(excess2) AS avg_second_excess FROM final;

WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS cnt FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), shares AS (SELECT sex, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM sex_counts), above AS (SELECT cnt, share, cnt - avg_cnt AS excess FROM shares WHERE cnt > avg_cnt) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM above;

WITH item_counts AS (

         COUNT(*) AS item_count

WITH grp AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS zoneref, s.insurstat, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_minus_gpu FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), meanref AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_gb) AS mean_avg_remaining FROM grp) SELECT g.zoneref AS site_code, g.insurstat AS insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_gb, g.avg_cpu_minus_gpu, g.avg_remaining_gb / m.mean_avg_remaining AS remaining_ratio FROM grp g CROSS JOIN meanref m WHERE m.mean_avg_remaining IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH per_currency AS (

WITH patient_level AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(l.UN / l.`T-BIL`) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_level AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_level GROUP BY SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS mean_alb FROM sex_level) SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_alb, s.avg_ratio, s.avg_alb - o.mean_alb AS alb_above_mean FROM sex_level s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_alb > o.mean_alb;
