ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_members FROM member), major_counts AS (SELECT m.major_id, m.department, COUNT(mb.member_id) AS member_count FROM major m JOIN member mb ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.major_id, m.department), shares AS (SELECT mc.major_id, mc.department, mc.member_count, 1.0 * mc.member_count / t.total_members AS share FROM major_counts mc CROSS JOIN total t), dept_avg AS (SELECT department, AVG(share) AS dept_avg_share FROM shares GROUP BY department) SELECT s.major_id, s.department, s.member_count, s.share, s.share - d.dept_avg_share AS share_above_dept_avg FROM shares s JOIN dept_avg d ON d.department IS s.department WHERE s.share > d.dept_avg_share ORDER BY share_above_dept_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS base FROM station_avg), above AS (SELECT s.avg_bw, b.base FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE s.avg_bw > b.base) SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_above_avg, AVG(avg_bw - base) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM above;

WITH tel_avg AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
baseline1 AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS b1
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
),
kept1 AS (
  SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_pulse
  FROM tel_avg t
  CROSS JOIN baseline1 b
  WHERE t.avg_pulse > b.b1
),
baseline2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS b2
  FROM kept1
),
kept2 AS (
  SELECT k.telescref, k.avg_pulse
  FROM kept1 k
  CROSS JOIN baseline2 b
  WHERE k.avg_pulse > b.b2
)
SELECT
  AVG(k.avg_pulse) AS mean_avg_pulse,
  AVG(k.avg_pulse - b1.b1) AS mean_excess_over_baseline1,
  AVG(k.avg_pulse - b2.b2) AS mean_excess_over_baseline2
FROM kept2 k
CROSS JOIN baseline1 b1
CROSS JOIN baseline2 b2;

WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM per_event), shares AS (SELECT p.event_id, p.cnt, CAST(p.cnt AS REAL) / t.total_cnt AS share FROM per_event p CROSS JOIN total t WHERE t.total_cnt IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT event_id, cnt, share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST) AS rk FROM shares) SELECT event_id, cnt, share FROM ranked WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST, event_id;

WITH grp AS (SELECT ordersmark AS order_ref, COUNT(*) AS exec_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), tot AS (SELECT SUM(exec_count) AS total_execs FROM grp), shares AS (SELECT g.order_ref, g.exec_count, CAST(g.exec_count AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / t.total_execs AS share FROM grp g CROSS JOIN tot t), diffs AS (SELECT s.order_ref, s.exec_count, s.share, s.share - AVG(s.share) OVER () AS share_diff FROM shares s), ranked AS (SELECT d.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.share_diff DESC NULLS LAST) AS diff_rank FROM diffs d) SELECT order_ref, exec_count, share, share_diff FROM ranked WHERE diff_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share_diff DESC NULLS LAST

WITH cust AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total_spent FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), shares AS (SELECT CustomerId, total_spent, total_spent * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_spent) FROM cust) AS share FROM cust), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.* FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share WHERE s.share > avg_share.a) SELECT AVG(k.total_spent) AS avg_total_spent, AVG(k.share) AS avg_share, AVG((k.share - avg_share.a) / avg_share.a) AS avg_relative_difference FROM kept k CROSS JOIN avg_share;

WITH site_totals AS (
  SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
shares AS (
  SELECT zoneref, feature_count,
         feature_count::numeric / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM site_totals
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code,
       s.feature_count,
       s.share,
       s.share - a.avg_share AS margin_above_avg
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_count FROM counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT c.observstation,
         c.telescope_count,
         CAST(c.telescope_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share
  FROM counts c
  CROSS JOIN total t
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.telescope_count,
       s.share,
       s.share - a.avg_share AS share_diff
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
ORDER BY share_diff DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH race_entries AS (SELECT cr.raceId, c.country, COUNT(*) AS entry_count, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country), stats AS (SELECT AVG(entry_count) AS avg_entries FROM race_entries), cutoff AS (SELECT entry_count AS cutoff_count FROM race_entries ORDER BY entry_count DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) SELECT re.raceId, re.country, re.total_points, re.entry_count, re.entry_count - s.avg_entries AS above_avg_by FROM race_entries re CROSS JOIN stats s CROSS JOIN cutoff co WHERE re.entry_count > s.avg_entries AND re.entry_count >= co.cutoff_count ORDER BY above_avg_by DESC

WITH cat AS (SELECT category, AVG(CASE WHEN spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount <> 0 THEN (spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount END) AS avg_rel_overspend, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM budget GROUP BY category), base AS (SELECT AVG(line_count) AS avg_lines FROM cat), kept AS (SELECT c.avg_rel_overspend, c.line_count FROM cat c JOIN base b ON c.line_count > b.avg_lines) SELECT AVG(k.avg_rel_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(k.line_count) AS avg_line_count, AVG(k.line_count - b.avg_lines) AS avg_excess_line_count FROM kept k CROSS JOIN base b;

SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) AS order_share FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY order_share DESC NULLS LAST, customer_id ASC LIMIT 10;

WITH team_stats AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(w) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS avg_wins, AVG((g - l) * 1.0 / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_gl_ratio FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), mean_wins AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins FROM team_stats) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_wins, t.avg_gl_ratio, t.avg_wins - m.mean_avg_wins AS gap FROM team_stats t CROSS JOIN mean_wins m WHERE t.avg_wins > m.mean_avg_wins ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), shares AS (SELECT city, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), stats AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.member_count, s.share FROM shares s, stats st WHERE s.share > st.avg_share) SELECT AVG(a.member_count) AS avg_count, AVG(a.share) AS avg_share, AVG(a.share - st.avg_share) AS avg_share_above_average FROM above a, stats st;

WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_igm FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igm) AS overall_mean FROM per_patient), dev AS (SELECT pp.ID, pp.SEX, pp.avg_igm, pp.avg_igm - o.overall_mean AS deviation FROM per_patient pp CROSS JOIN overall o), sex_avg AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS avg_dev FROM dev GROUP BY SEX), ranked AS (SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.avg_igm, d.deviation, d.deviation - s.avg_dev AS excess FROM dev d JOIN sex_avg s ON s.SEX = d.SEX WHERE d.deviation > s.avg_dev) SELECT ID, SEX, avg_igm AS `aCL IgM`, deviation, excess FROM ranked ORDER BY excess IS NULL, excess DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH grp AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(`ANA Pattern`), '') AS pattern, `aCL IgG` AS igg FROM Examination), group_avg AS (SELECT pattern, AVG(igg) AS avg_igg FROM grp GROUP BY pattern), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS mean_avg FROM group_avg), kept AS (SELECT g.pattern, g.avg_igg, g.avg_igg - o.mean_avg AS above_mean FROM group_avg g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_igg > o.mean_avg) SELECT k.pattern, k.avg_igg, k.above_mean, k.avg_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) FROM kept) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept k ORDER BY k.avg_igg DESC;

WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount FROM ev, overall WHERE ev.avg_amount > overall.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.link_to_event, k.avg_amount, k.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS above_overall, k.avg_amount - m.kept_avg AS above_kept_mean FROM kept k, overall o, kept_mean m ORDER BY above_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10

WITH src AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS proj_cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), stats AS (SELECT AVG(proj_cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM src), kept AS (SELECT src.ratio, src.proj_cnt, stats.avg_cnt FROM src CROSS JOIN stats WHERE src.proj_cnt > stats.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(proj_cnt) AS total_projects, AVG(proj_cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_count_excess FROM kept;

WITH player_totals AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.player_id, p.death_country), avg_total AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM player_totals), above AS (SELECT pt.total, pt.total - at.avg_total AS excess FROM player_totals pt CROSS JOIN avg_total at WHERE pt.total > at.avg_total) SELECT SUM(total) AS sum_totals, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM above;

WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS base
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
grp AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS grp_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
above AS (
  SELECT g.grp_avg, g.grp_avg - b.base AS excess
  FROM grp g
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE g.grp_avg > b.base
)
SELECT AVG(grp_avg) AS mean_group_avg,
       AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM above;

WITH per_store AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS active_customers FROM customer WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY store_id) SELECT store_id, active_customers, active_customers / (SELECT SUM(active_customers) FROM per_store) AS share_of_total, active_customers / (SELECT AVG(active_customers) FROM per_store) AS relative_to_average FROM per_store ORDER BY store_id;

SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS distinct_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg)) OVER () AS share FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind;

WITH station_avg AS (
  SELECT t.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage
  FROM telescopes t
  GROUP BY t.observstation
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS overall_avg
  FROM station_avg
)
SELECT s.observstation,
       s.avg_bandusage,
       s.avg_bandusage - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall
FROM station_avg s
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE s.avg_bandusage > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY diff_above_overall DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH grouped AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(link_to_major) <> '' GROUP BY link_to_major), shares AS (SELECT link_to_major, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM grouped) AS share FROM grouped), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share FROM shares s, avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_members, AVG(share) AS avg_share_of_above, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM above;

WITH per_nat AS (SELECT c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT c.constructorId) AS constructor_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, constructor_count, constructor_count - AVG(constructor_count) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM per_nat ORDER BY nationality;

WITH joined AS (
  SELECT p.production_type_code AS code,
         pc.product_type_description AS description,
         CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL) AS qty,
         ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost AS cost_diff
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
),
cat AS (
  SELECT code, description,
         AVG(qty) AS avg_qty,
         AVG(cost_diff) AS avg_diff
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY code, description
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS mean_diff FROM cat
),
kept AS (
  SELECT c.avg_qty, c.avg_diff
  FROM cat c, threshold t
  WHERE c.avg_diff > t.mean_diff
)
SELECT AVG(k.avg_qty) AS avg_of_avg_quantity,
       AVG(k.avg_diff) AS avg_of_avg_cost_difference,
       AVG(k.avg_diff - t.mean_diff) AS avg_excess_over_mean
FROM kept k, threshold t;

WITH matched AS (SELECT s.zoneref, si.riskeval, s.pressratio FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref), grouped AS (SELECT zoneref AS site_code, riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM matched GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval), shared AS (SELECT site_code, risk_evaluation_status, avg_pressratio, scan_count, scan_count * 1.0 / SUM(scan_count) OVER () AS share FROM grouped), ranked AS (SELECT shared.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS share_rank FROM shared) SELECT site_code, risk_evaluation_status, avg_pressratio, scan_count, share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC

WITH type_avgs AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS base FROM type_avgs), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.avg_price FROM type_avgs t CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE t.avg_price > b.base), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS m FROM kept), remaining AS (SELECT k.avg_price FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean km WHERE k.avg_price > km.m) SELECT AVG(r.avg_price) AS type_avg_price, AVG(r.avg_price) - b.base AS above_baseline, AVG(r.avg_price) - km.m AS above_kept_mean FROM remaining r CROSS JOIN baseline b CROSS JOIN kept_mean km WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.base, km.m;

WITH counts AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), ranked AS (SELECT telescref, signal_count, signal_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) AS fraction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY signal_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) DESC) AS rnk FROM counts) SELECT telescref, signal_count, fraction FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY fraction DESC;

WITH grp AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS behavior_count FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), shares AS (SELECT order_type_mix, behavior_count, CAST(behavior_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS share FROM grp), base AS (SELECT order_type_mix, behavior_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline_share FROM shares) SELECT order_type_mix, behavior_count, share, share - baseline_share AS above_baseline FROM base WHERE share > baseline_share;

WITH scan_ratio AS (
  SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0) AS ratio
  FROM scans s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
),
group_rate AS (
  SELECT arcref, fundflux, AVG(ratio) AS rate
  FROM scan_ratio
  WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY arcref, fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM group_rate
)
SELECT g.arcref AS project_ref, g.fundflux AS funding_source, g.rate AS rate, g.rate - b.bench AS excess
FROM group_rate g
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
WHERE g.rate > b.bench
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH per_test AS (SELECT ID, HGB * 1.0 / HCT AS r FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0), patient_ratio AS (SELECT ID, AVG(r) AS ratio FROM per_test GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg1 FROM patient_ratio), step1 AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - o.avg1 AS above1 FROM patient_ratio p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg1), group2 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg2 FROM step1), step2 AS (SELECT s.ID, s.ratio, s.above1, s.ratio - g.avg2 AS above2 FROM step1 s CROSS JOIN group2 g WHERE s.ratio > g.avg2) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(above1) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(above2) AS avg_above_second FROM step2;

WITH grp AS (SELECT corpeventprx AS event_type, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_abs_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE corpeventprx IS NOT NULL GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_abs_diff) AS overall_avg FROM grp) SELECT g.event_type, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_abs_diff, g.avg_abs_diff - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL;

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT m.zoneref, m.facetfaces, s.entrystat
  FROM scanmesh m
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(facetfaces) AS base
  FROM matched
  WHERE facetfaces IS NOT NULL
),
site_avg AS (
  SELECT zoneref, entrystat, AVG(facetfaces) AS site_avg
  FROM matched
  WHERE facetfaces IS NOT NULL AND entrystat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat
),
status_avg AS (
  SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg) AS status_avg
  FROM site_avg
  GROUP BY entrystat
),
kept AS (
  SELECT sa.site_avg, st.status_avg, b.base
  FROM site_avg sa
  JOIN status_avg st ON st.entrystat = sa.entrystat
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE sa.site_avg > st.status_avg
    AND b.base IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  AVG(site_avg) AS avg_kept_site_average,
  AVG(site_avg - base) AS avg_excess_over_baseline,
  AVG(site_avg - status_avg) AS avg_excess_over_status_average
FROM kept;

WITH name_stats AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM name_stats), kept AS (SELECT n.* FROM name_stats n, overall o WHERE n.cnt > o.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(k.avg_points) AS avg_of_avg_points, AVG(k.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(k.cnt - o.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_count FROM kept k, overall o;

WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT td.tradekind, ab.translink, COUNT(*) AS rec_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader td ON td.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY td.tradekind, ab.translink), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, translink, rec_count, rec_count::numeric / SUM(rec_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM pair_counts), type_avg AS (SELECT tradekind, rec_count, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT * FROM type_avg WHERE share >= type_avg_share) SELECT tradekind AS trader_type, AVG(rec_count) AS avg_record_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - type_avg_share) AS avg_share_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind;

WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT c.college_id,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.state), ''), '') AS state,
         COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS cnt
  FROM player_college pc
  JOIN college c ON c.college_id = pc.college_id
  GROUP BY c.college_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.state), ''), '')
),
stats AS (
  SELECT college_id, state, cnt,
         AVG(cnt) OVER () AS overall_avg,
         SUM(cnt) OVER () AS total
  FROM college_counts
)
SELECT state,
       AVG(cnt) AS avg_count,
       AVG(cnt * 1.0 / overall_avg) AS avg_count_ratio_to_overall_avg,
       AVG(cnt * 1.0 / total) AS avg_share_of_total
FROM stats
GROUP BY state;

WITH region_counts AS (SELECT dt.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM disp d JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY dt.A3), shares AS (SELECT region, cnt, 1.0 * cnt / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM region_counts) AS share FROM region_counts), stats AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, st.avg_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE s.share > st.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM above;

WITH votes AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.death_country IS NULL OR TRIM(p.death_country) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.death_country END AS death_country, v.points_won FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id), group_avgs AS (SELECT death_country, AVG(points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM votes GROUP BY death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM group_avgs) AS diff_from_mean_of_group_avgs FROM group_avgs ORDER BY death_country;

WITH joined AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune
  FROM orderexecutions e
  JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark
),
counts AS (
  SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY ordertune
),
shares AS (
  SELECT ordertune, cnt,
         CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share
  FROM counts
),
avgs AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count,
       AVG(s.share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN avgs a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;

WITH pair AS (SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = t.trdref GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS overall_mean FROM pair), kept AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - st.overall_mean AS above_mean FROM pair p CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE p.pair_avg > st.overall_mean), per_type AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_analyst, AVG(above_mean) AS avg_above FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst, avg_above, avg_analyst / (SELECT AVG(avg_analyst) FROM per_type) AS ratio_to_mean FROM per_type

WITH rated AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS films
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(films) AS avg_films FROM rated
),
above AS (
  SELECT r.films
  FROM rated r
  JOIN overall o ON r.films > o.avg_films
)
SELECT AVG(a.films) AS avg_count_above_average,
       AVG(a.films - o.avg_films) AS avg_excess_over_overall_average
FROM above a
CROSS JOIN overall o;

WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, SUM(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(product_price) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv), kept AS (SELECT i.avg_cost, i.ratio FROM inv i CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE i.ratio > o.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(k.avg_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, AVG(k.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(k.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_excess FROM kept k CROSS JOIN overall o;

WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) AS avg_rate FROM album_stats WHERE AlbumId IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.AlbumId, s.avg_unit_price, s.bytes_per_ms, s.bytes_per_ms - o.avg_rate AS rate_diff FROM album_stats s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.AlbumId IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rate_diff DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH actor_counts AS (
  SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY actor_id
),
totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS total_films
  FROM film_actor
),
ratios AS (
  SELECT ac.actor_id, ac.film_count, ac.film_count * 1.0 / t.total_films AS ratio
  FROM actor_counts ac
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT r.actor_id, r.film_count, r.ratio, r.ratio - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM ratios) AS diff_from_avg
FROM ratios r
ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH joined AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, (f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0) AS relgap
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
),
grp AS (
  SELECT orderslink, ordertune, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(relgap) AS avg_relgap
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune
),
base AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS baseline FROM grp
)
SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune AS order_type, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_relgap, g.avg_rebate - b.baseline AS excess_over_baseline
FROM grp g
CROSS JOIN base b
WHERE g.avg_rebate > b.baseline
ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH joined AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, r.round FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), circuit_avg AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS circuit_avg_round FROM joined GROUP BY circuitId, country), country_base AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS country_avg_round FROM joined GROUP BY country) SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.circuit_avg_round, ca.circuit_avg_round - cb.country_avg_round AS diff_from_country_baseline FROM circuit_avg ca JOIN country_base cb ON cb.country IS ca.country ORDER BY diff_from_country_baseline DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH equip_avg AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg FROM equip_avg), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, e.avg_humidity - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall FROM equip_avg e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE e.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS kept_avg FROM kept), ranked AS (SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_humidity, k.excess_over_overall, ABS(k.avg_humidity - m.kept_avg) AS dist_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m), top_ranked AS (SELECT r.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.dist_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM ranked r) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, excess_over_overall, dist_from_kept_mean FROM top_ranked WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY dist_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH votes AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN p.death_country IS NULL OR TRIM(p.death_country) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.death_country END AS country,
         1.0 * v.points_won / v.points_max AS ratio
  FROM player_award_vote v
  JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
  WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max > 0
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM votes
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT country,
       avg_ratio,
       avg_ratio / (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM country_avg) AS ratio_to_mean_of_countries
FROM country_avg
ORDER BY country;

WITH pair_avg AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avg
),
kept AS (
  SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_feerate, p.avg_feerate - s.mean_avg AS excess
  FROM pair_avg p
  CROSS JOIN stats s
  WHERE p.avg_feerate > s.mean_avg
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT k.orderslink, k.acctscope, k.avg_feerate, k.excess,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k.acctscope ORDER BY k.excess DESC, k.orderslink ASC) AS rnk
  FROM kept k
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rnk
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, rnk;
